to.home.why-totem-astrology.p.at-the-heart-: Ko e uho 'o e Totem Astrology 'oku 'i ai 'a e 'amanaki: 'amanaki ki ha mahino mahino ange kiate koe, 'amanaki ki ha mahino lelei ange 'i he vaha'a 'o e ngaahi hoa mo e kau mēmipa 'o e famili, pea 'amanaki 'oku 'i ai ha kakai 'i tu'a 'oku nau fe'unga mo koe 'i he founga pe 'oku ke 'i ai.
to.home.why-totem-astrology.p.this-is-a-too: Ko e meʻangāue ʻeni ki he femahinoʻakí mo ʻoatu ʻa e ʻaloʻofá — ʻaloʻofa ʻoku fanauʻi mai mei he mahino ʻetau ngaahi faikehekehé mo houngaʻia ʻi he ngaahi founga kehekehe ʻoku ngaʻunu ai ʻa e kakaí ʻi he māmaní. Ko e not ko e ‘uhinga ia ki he ‘ulungaanga kovi, pea ‘oku ‘ikai ko ha ‘uhinga ia ke tali ai ‘a e ‘ulungaanga kovi ‘a e kakai kehe ‘i he taimi ‘oku fai ai ha maumau. Ko e Totem Astrology 'oku 'uhinga ia ke fakamaama, 'ikai ke fakapopula'i: 'oku tau ako 'a e feitu'u 'oku tau kehekehe ai ke tau lava 'o fakahaa'i ma'atautolu mo e taha mo e taha 'aki 'a e kataki lahi ange, 'ikai ke si'isi'i ange 'a e taliui.

to.page.faq.animal-names.p.i-have-updated-t: Kuo u fakafo'ou 'a e ngaahi hingoa 'o e fanga monumanu 'o fakatatau ki he'eku ngaahi faka'uhinga ki he laumalie 'o honau ngaahi 'ulungaanga 'o hange ko ia 'oku fakamatala'i 'i he Sotiaki Hahake. ʻOku talitali lelei koe ke ke ʻave ki ha meʻa pē ʻokú ke ʻilo ʻoku fekauʻaki mo koe pea liʻaki ha meʻa pē ʻoku ʻikai ke ongo. ʻIkai ha ngaahi afo ʻoku fakapipiki! ʻOku ʻuhinga kotoa ʻeni ke fakafiefia! ‘Oku ou ‘amanaki te ke fiefia ‘o hangē ko aú, pea ‘oku ou ‘amanaki te ke lava ‘o sio ki he kakai ‘oku nau ‘ātakai‘i koé ‘o fakafou ‘i ha matasio‘ata fo‘ou ‘o e mahino ‘o hangē ko ia ‘oku ou ma‘ú ‘aki hono ngāue‘aki ‘a e founga ko ‘eni ‘o e ngaahi fakahinohino ‘o e fanga manú kiate koe mo ho ngaahi ‘ofa‘angá. Kuo ne liliu mo'oni 'eku founga 'o e vakai ki he mamani mo e founga 'oku ou fekau'aki ai mo au 'i loto, pea 'oku ou vēkeveke ke vahevahe atu ia mo kimoutolu kotoa :)
to.page.faq.unknown-birth-time.p.a-final-bi: Ko ha tokoni lahi faka’osi ko e Nepal Time Zone shift, ‘a ia ‘oku fa’a ‘uhinga ia ki he kau clients ‘i he Hihifo kapau na’e fanau’i kinautolu ‘i he pongipongi, te nau ma’u ha monumanu kehe ‘o e ‘AHO (Loto) ‘o hange ko ia kapau na’e fanau’i kinautolu ‘i he efiafi. Ko ia kapau 'oku kehekehe 'aupito 'a e ongo monumanu kaunga'api ko 'eni 'i he 'ulungaanga, hange ko e pehe, 'a e Hoosi mo e Ngata, pe ko e Talakoni mo e Pusi, pea 'e lava ke tau fa'a fa'o hifo 'o 'ikai si'i hifo 'i he konga ko ia 'o e taimi 'o e fanau'i 'o ha taha neongo kapau 'oku 'ikai ha'atau fakamatala pau kehe 'i he me'a kotoa pe — Cat Hearts 'ulungaanga kehe 'aupito ia mei he Talakoni Loto kehe instantly kapau 'e 'ilo 'e he tokolahi taha 'o e kakai 'i he)
to.page.faq.unknown-birth-time.p.i-can-usua: ‘Oku ou fa‘a lava ‘o tokoni ki he me‘á ni ‘o kapau pē ‘oku ou lava ‘o sio ki he tokotahá koe‘uhi kuó u fetaulaki mo e kakai ‘e lauiafe ‘i he ngaahi konitinēniti ‘e ono mo e ngaahi fakahinohino takitaha ‘o e fanga monumanu sino kehekehe ‘e 12, ko ia ‘i he taimi ní kuó u to‘o hake ha ngaahi founga si‘isi‘i ki hono ‘ilo‘i pe ko fē ‘oku ngāue mo ha taha. ‘Oku ou kei lava pē ‘o fai ha ngaahi fehālaaki ‘o hangē pē ko ha taha pē, ka kuó u tonu fe‘unga ‘i he ngaahi taimi ke ma‘u ai ha falala mālohi ‘aupito ki hoku ngaahi malava faka‘atamaí heni — ‘i he taimi ‘e taha na‘e a‘u ai ‘o u ma‘u ha taha ‘o telefoni mai kiate au ‘i he ‘aho hono hokó hili ‘enau fakapapau‘i na‘á ku hala ke toki ‘ilo‘i na‘a nau lau hala ‘a e AM/PM ‘i he‘enau tohi fā‘elé pea na‘á ku mo‘oni! :)
to.page.faq.unknown-birth-time.p.yes-it-jus: ‘Io, ‘oku fiema‘u pē ha ki‘i fiddling! 'E lava ke tricky 'a e taha ko 'eni — ko e me'a 'oku ou fa'a fai ma'a e kau clients ko e 'uluaki 'ai ke nau kumi ha ngaahi lekooti hange ko ha tohi fanau ke vakai pe na'e fakahu 'a e fakamatala 'i ai. Hoko atu 'oku ou kole atu ke nau a'u atu ki he ngaahi kainga (kamata mei he mom!) ke vakai pe 'oku 'iai ha taha kehe 'e lava ke tokoni'i kinautolu ke nau pin down honau taimi totonu 'o e fanau'i. Faka’osí, kapau ‘oku tau ma’u ha matapā sio’ata pau ‘o e taimi ke ngāue ‘i loto — hangē ko ‘ení: “ ‘Oku pehē ‘e he’eku fa’eé ‘okú ne fakakaukau na’e fā’ele’i au ‘i he pongipongí ‘i ha taimi ‘oku ‘ikai fu’u fuoloa hili ‘a e hopo ‘a e la’aá ka ‘oku pau pē ki mu’a ‘i he ma’u me’atokoni ho’ataá,” pea ‘e lava ke tau kamata ke vakai ki he fanga monumanu sino kotoa pē ‘e lava ke hoko ‘i he matapā sio’ata taimi ko iá pea vakai pe ko e fē ‘oku resonates lahi taha mo e tokotahá.
to.page.faq.unknown-birth-time.p.so-these-a: Ko ia ko e ngaahi fehu'i lelei kotoa pe 'eni ke 'omi hake 'i ha lau — neongo kapau kuo pekia ho'o ongo matu'a pea na'e mole ho'o tohi fanau 'i ha tafea, 'e lava ke tau vakai'i 'a e ngaahi fakataha'anga fakahinohino monumanu 'e lava ke Loto mo e Sino pea fakapuliki ia ki ha me'a 'oku ongo totonu kiate koe pea toe vakai'i 'a e kakai 'oku nau 'ilo'i lelei taha koe. ‘I he ngaahi fa’ahinga kehe ‘o e fetu’utaki ‘e ui ‘eni ko e “fakatonutonu ho’o saati fanau’i”, pea ‘oku pau ko ha me’a ia te u lava ‘o tokoni’i koe. Te tau faka’aonga’i ‘eku Totem Astrology system pea pehe ki he angamaheni ange ‘o e Western aka Tropical Zodiac ‘a ia ‘oku ou fu’u taukei ‘aupito ai, pea na’a mo e Vedic aka Sidereal Zodiac ‘a ia na’a ku toki kamata ako ‘i he ngaahi ta’u kimui ni mai ka kuo u ma’u ha mahino tefito ki ai. Toe fakalea atu, ‘oku ‘uhinga kotoa ‘eni ke hoko ko ha ngaahi me’angaue ke tokoni’i koe ‘i ho’o fononga ke fakamaama koe mo e ni’ihi kehe, ko ia tau fiefia ‘i he me’a ni pea tau ako fakataha!
to.page.faq.partner-compatibility.p.another: Ko e taha ʻoku ou fanongo maʻu pē ki ai:
to.page.faq.unknown-birth-time.p.these-are-: Ko e fanga ki’i momeniti fakafiefia ‘eni ‘o e fakatonuhia, ka ‘oku mahu’inga foki ke manatu’i ‘i he taimi kotoa pe ‘oku ‘uhinga ‘a e konga kotoa pe ‘o e me’a ni ke hoko ko ha fakahinohino tokoni, ‘o ‘ikai ko ha fakapapau’i fefeka ‘o e iku’anga! Kapau ‘oku ‘ikai ke nofo tonu ha me‘a mo koe pe ‘ikai ke ongo‘i, chuck ia ‘i he taimi pē ko iá! ‘Oku ‘ikai keu ‘i heni ke tala ki ha taha ‘a e founga kuo pau ke nau mo’ui ai, ‘oku ou ‘i heni pe ke ‘oatu ha fale’i kapau ‘oku fiema’u pea tokoni’i koe ke ke ‘ilo’i ‘a e ni’ihi ‘o e ngaahi me’a ‘oku ke piki ki ai ‘i he taimi mo e feitu’u te u lava ai. Ko e fetu‘utaki fakalūkufuá ‘oku totonu ke fakafiefia mo ‘ilo‘ilo pau, ‘o ‘ikai ko ha tautea pilīsone ‘okú ne fakapapau‘i ‘a e founga ‘e ‘alu ai ho‘o mo‘uí pe ko ha kofu fakamālohi ‘okú ne fakangatangata ho‘o ngaahi filí. Totem Astrology tautautefito kuo fa’u ‘e au tautautefito ko ha me’angaue ke tokoni’i koe ke mahino lelei ange kiate koe mo e ni’ihi kehe, ko ia ko e miniti ‘oku ongo’i ai ‘oku ‘ikai ke ne fai ia, tuku ia ki he tafa’aki! ‘Oku tau ‘i heni ke tupulaki, ‘o ‘ikai ke faka’ai’ai pe faka’ai’ai ‘a e ni’ihi kehe.
to.page.faq.partner-compatibility.p.oh-no-y: “’Oiauē ‘ikai! ‘Oku pehē ‘e ho’o me’a fakafuofua ‘oku ‘ikai ke u fe’unga mo hoku hoá! ‘Oku ‘uhinga ‘eni ‘oku totonu ke u movete mo kinaua?”
to.page.faq.partner-compatibility.p.totem-a: ‘Oku ‘i heni ‘a e Totem Astrology ke tokoni’i koe ke ke ako ke ke lea lelei ange ‘i he ngaahi lea mahu’inga ‘o e taha mo e taha pea ke mahino kiate koe ‘a e taimi ‘oku ngali ‘oku ke fiema’u ai ha ngaahi me’a kehekehe ka ‘e ‘ikai nai ke ke ma’u ha ngaahi lea ke ke talanoa ai ki he ngaahi faikehekehe ko ia. Kapau ‘oku feinga ha Manuki ke kaka ha Pafalo ‘i ha ‘akau, mahalo ‘e ‘ikai ke sai’ia ‘a e Pafalo ‘i he fakaanga mo e faka’ai’ai ma’u pe ‘e he Manuki ‘o pehe “’oku faingofua! ‘E lava ‘e ha taha pe!” Koe’uhi ko e kakai kitautolu, pea ko ‘etau ngaahi fakahinohino monumanu pe ‘eni, ‘e lava ke tokoni ke fakatokanga’i ‘a e feitu’u ‘oku tau ala ma’u ai ‘a e fale’i fepakipaki mei he ngaahi fakahinohino kehekehe ‘i loto ‘iate kitautolu, pea pehe ki he ngaahi faikehekehe ‘i he vaha’a ‘o ‘etau kau fakahinohino mo e ngaahi fakahinohino ‘o hotau ngaahi ‘ofa’anga.
to.page.faq.partner-compatibility.p.these-a: Ko e ngaahi fakahinohino monumanu ko ení ko ha me‘a‘ofa ia, ‘o ‘ikai ko ha tautea! Ko ia, ʻalu faingofua kiate koe, pea ʻalu faingofua kiate kinautolu ʻoku nau ʻātakaiʻi koé. ‘Oku tau ‘i heni kotoa ‘i he loony bin ko ‘eni ‘o fai ‘a e lelei taha te tau lava, pea kapau te tau tō hifo he ‘aho ni, te tau lava ‘o toe to’o hake kitautolu ‘apongipongi. Ko e me’a ‘oku toe lelei ange, ‘e lava ke tau fetokoni’aki, tautautefito ki he taimi ‘oku tau ‘ilo lahi ange ai ki he me’a ‘e ala takitaha fiema’u mo e feitu’u ‘oku tau ha’u mei ai. Ko e lahi taha ‘o e ngaahi ngāue kuó u fai mo e ngaahi fāmilí ‘oku lele ia ‘i he ngaahi laine ko ‘ení — tokoni‘i ‘a e ngaahi mātu‘á ke mahino kiate kinautolu ‘a e me‘a ‘oku hoko ‘i he ‘uto ‘o ‘enau fānaú, pea tokoni‘i ‘a e fānaú ke mahino kiate kinautolu ‘a e feitu‘u ‘oku ha‘u mei ai ‘a e ngaahi tu‘unga mo‘ui ‘o ‘enau mātu‘á.
to.page.faq.partner-compatibility.p.using-t: ‘I hono ngāue’aki ‘a e lea ‘o e sisitemi fakafetu’u ko ‘ení, ‘e lava ke tau talanoa ki he ngaahi faikehekehe ko iá ‘i ha founga ‘oku ngali si’isi’i ange ai ‘a e fakafo’ituituí he ‘oku ‘i ai ‘etau ngaahi faka’ilonga monumanu ke tau falala ki ai ke mahino. Pea ‘e lava leva ‘e he tokotaha ‘oku ‘i ai ‘ene fakahinohino ‘o e Monkey ‘o tangutu hifo ‘o ‘alu “gotcha, ‘oku ‘ikai sai’ia ho’o Pafalo ‘i he ‘ulu ki lalo, ‘oku ‘uhinga kakato ia,” pea tukuange pe ia. ‘I hono lelei tahá, ‘oku tokoni‘i kitautolu ‘e he Totem Astrology ke ‘oua ‘e ngata pē ‘i he‘etau femotuhi‘aki ha ngaahi slack ‘i he‘etau kehekehé, ka ke tau kātoanga‘i mo‘oni ‘a e ngaahi faikehekehe ko iá pea ako ‘a e feitu‘u ‘oku nau ha‘u mei aí koe‘uhi ke ‘oua na‘a tau fu‘u fakamaau‘i ‘i he taimi kotoa pē!
to.page.faq.partner-compatibility.p.it-also: ʻOkú ne tokoniʻi foki kitautolu ke tau sio ki he founga ʻoku fehokotaki ai ʻa e ngaahi konga lelei ʻo e niʻihi kehé ki he ngaahi konga te tau ala vakai ki ai ko e ngaahi fehālaakí —hangē ko ʻení, mahalo ʻe tōmui nai haʻo kaungāmeʻa ki he ngaahi ʻapoinimení ʻi ha taimi lahi, ʻo hangē ʻoku ʻi he ʻaó honau ʻulú. Mahalo kuo nau ma’u ‘a e Pusi pe ko e Tia ko e taha ‘o ‘enau ngaahi fakahinohino, koe’uhi ke ha’u ‘a e tardiness ‘o fakatahataha’i mo ha tu’unga mo’ui lelei ‘o e fa’ufa’u fakamisiteli! Pe mahalo ko e taha ‘o ‘enau kau fakahinohinó ko ha Taika pe ko ha Hoosi, pea ko ‘enau toutou tōmui ki he ngaahi ‘apoinimeni kuo fakataimitēpile‘í ‘oku ha‘u fakataha ia mo ha mateuteu ke puna loto-to‘a ki he ngāué ‘i ha ki‘i momeniti pē! ‘Oku ‘ikai ko ha ngaahi ‘uhinga ‘eni ki he tō’onga ta’efaka’apa’apa, ka ko e ngaahi matapā sio’ata ia ki he me’a ‘oku ala hoko ‘i loto ‘iate koe pe ko ha taha kehe — ‘o taumu’a ma’u pē ke fakatonutonu ha ngaahi tōnounou ‘i loto pea ke ke anga’ofa ‘i he halá mo e ngaahi tōnounou ‘a e ni’ihi kehé.
to.page.faq.partner-compatibility.p.absolut: ‘Oku ‘ikai ‘aupito! Mo e kamata, ko e me'a pe 'oku 'uhinga 'a e sisitemi ko 'eni ke talaatu pe ko e ha ho'o ngaahi hehema 'i loto, pea mo e ngaahi hehema 'a ho hoa foki 'i he keisi ko 'eni. Ko e meʻa te ke fai ki he ngaahi hehema ko iá ʻoku kei ʻiate koe pē ia — fili tauʻatāiná, manatuʻi? :) Ko ia koe’uhi pē ko e fakahinohino monumanu ‘a ho hoá ‘oku ‘ikai ke ne lea ‘i he lea tatau mo ho’o pe align haohaoa mo koe ‘i he ‘īsiu kotoa pē, mate’i mai pe ko e hā? Ko e me’a angamaheni ‘aupito ia! ‘Oku tau ‘i heni kotoa ke ako. ‘Oku faingata’a’ia ‘a e kakai, ‘oku toe faingata’a ange ‘a e ngaahi feohi’anga, pea neongo kapau na’a ke ma’u ‘a e perfect fe’unga fakafetu’u ‘e kei ‘i ai pe ‘a e ngaahi momeniti ‘o e ta’efelotoi ‘oku ‘ikai ke ke sio mata ki he mata. Kuo pau pē ke ke fakahaaʻi koe, pea ʻoku kei fie maʻu pē ke ke fakahaaʻi ho hoá.
to.page.faq.same-animals-different-people.p: “ʻOku tatau pē ʻa e monumanu Taʻu/ʻAtamai/ʻAho/Houa ʻa hoku kaungāmeʻá mo au ka ʻoku nau kei fuʻu kehekehe ʻaupito! ʻOku malava fēfē ia?”
Pea 'oku ha'u 'a e taha ko 'eni 'o lahi foki:
to.page.faq.p.read-how-the-system-works-try: Lau ʻa e founga ʻoku ngāue ai ʻa e sisitemí, ʻahiʻahiʻi ʻa e meʻa fakafuofua, pe ʻave ha pōpoaki kapau ʻoku ʻi ai ha meʻa kehe ʻi ho ʻatamaí.
to.page.faq.p.more-questions-and-answers-wi: ʻE tānaki atu heni ha ngaahi fehuʻi mo ha ngaahi tali lahi ange ʻi heʻenau ʻasi haké.
to.page.faq.same-animals-different-people.p: Pea ‘oku ‘ikai ko e Totem Astrology ‘a e me’a kotoa pe ‘oku ‘i mamani, ‘o hange pe ko ha konga kehe ‘o ho’o ‘ulungaanga ‘oku ke ‘ofa’i ‘oku ‘ikai ko ho’o ‘ulungaanga kakato foki: ko ho matakali, ho’o lotu, fonua ‘oku ke mei ai, ‘e ala hoko kotoa ‘eni ko e ngaahi konga mahu’inga ‘o kitautolu, pea ‘oku mahu’inga ange ia ‘i he taimi ‘e ni’ihi ‘i he taimi ‘e ni’ihi, pea mahu’inga ange ki he kakai ‘e ni’ihi ‘i he taimi ‘e ni’ihi. Me’a tatau mo e Totem Astrology — mahalo ‘oku mahu’inga ‘aupito ia ‘i ho’o ngaahi feohi he ‘aho ni, mahalo ‘oku ‘ikai! To’o ia mo ha fo’i masima, ‘oku ‘uhinga ia ke faka’ilo mo fakafiefia’i — ‘o ‘ikai ko ha kavenga pe ko ha fakamala’ia, ‘oku ‘uhinga ia ke hoko ko ha tapuaki! Ko ia fiefia ai :)
to.page.faq.partner-compatibility.p.that-dr: Ko e Talakoni ko ia ‘oku ‘alu ke ne fiema’u ‘a e faka’apa’apa (pea ‘oku sai ange ke foaki ia ‘i he totongi!), pea ‘oku ‘alu ‘a e Pusi ko ia ke ne fakahounga’i ho’o faka’apa’apa ki hono feitu’u ‘o ‘ikai fiema’u ma’u pe ke ke vakai’i, pea ‘i he’ene hoko ‘oku ngalingali te ne tapuaki’i koe ‘aki ‘a e ngaahi me’a faka’ohovale fakaofo ta’e’amanekina ‘i he taimi ‘oku taa’i ai ‘e he ‘ofa ‘a e mood. Kapau ‘oku ‘i ai ha me’a ‘e taha te tau lava ‘o ako mei he sisitemi ko ‘eni, ko e founga ke tau fekataki’aki ai, ke tau sio loloto ange mo feinga ke sio ki he me’a ‘oku ne ue’i ‘a e alternative take on reality tukukehe ‘a e default “you’re an idiot!” ‘Oku tau lelei ange ‘i he me’a ko ia, pea ‘e lava ke tau fefakafeangai’aki lelei ange ‘i he me’a ko ia, pea ‘oku ‘amanaki ‘e tokoni atu ‘eku sisitemi ke ‘oatu ha lea ‘oku toe lahi ange ke ke fai ‘aki ‘a e me’a ko ia. Fakalata! :)
to.page.faq.same-animals-different-people.p: Sai 'e lava ke ke fakakaukau ki he fanga monumanu hange ko e ngaahi kaati na'e vahevahe atu kiate koe 'i he kamata'anga 'o ha va'inga 'o e poker. Mahalo te ke fakatou maʻu ha 7 ʻo e Loto mo ha Siaki ʻo e Taimani, ka ko e founga te ke vaʻingaʻaki kinaua ʻi he vaʻingá ʻoku ʻiate koe ia pea ʻe kehe ʻaupito nai ʻene hā mei tuʻa, neongo ʻokú ke maʻu ha niʻihi ʻo e ngaahi kaati tatau. Pe te ke lava ‘o fakakaukau ki ai ‘o hangē ha ngaahi tohi lalahi kuó ke laú. ‘E lava ke lau ‘e ha ongo tangata kehekehe ‘a e tohi ‘e fā tatau pea nau toki fai ha lea ‘apongipongi fekau’aki mo kinaua pea ‘e hoko ia ko ha ongo lea kehekehe ‘aupito, neongo ‘oku ‘i he kaveinga tatau ‘o e tohi ‘e fā ko iá. Ko e founga ia ‘oku ngaue ai ‘a e fanga monumanu: ‘oku nau ‘i ai ko ha ‘enisaikolopētia ke ke to’o mei ai ‘i ho’o mo’ui kotoa, ‘o ‘ikai ko ha ngaahi founga fakamea’a ‘oku ne talaatu pe ko hai koe pe ko hai kuo pau ke ke hoko ki ai. Ko e fakamatala pe ‘oku ke ma’u fekau’aki mo e ni’ihi ‘o e ngaahi me’a’ofa kuo foaki atu.

to.page.how.p.the-language-behind-your-four: Ko e lea ʻi mui ʻi hoʻo ngaahi fakahinohino totem ʻe faá — mo e ngaahi laʻi ʻoku nau liliu ha pou totem ki ha mape ke mahino ai kiate koe mo e niʻihi kehé.
to.page.how.li.why-totem-astrology: Ko e hā ʻa e ʻuhinga ʻoku Totem Astrology
to.page.how.li.four-guides: Ko e ngaahi fakahinohino ʻe fā
to.page.how.philosophy.p.this-system-is-not: Ko e fokotu'utu'u ko 'eni 'oku 'ikai ko ha 'uhinga ia ki he 'ulungaanga kovi, pea 'oku 'ikai ko ha fakangofua ke kataki'i 'a e 'ulungaanga kovi 'a e kakai kehe. Ko ha meʻangāue ia ki he mahinó — ki he sio ki he founga ʻoku ngāue ai ʻa e ngaahi founga kehekehe ʻi lotó, fakahoungaʻi ʻa e ngaahi faikehekehe ko iá, mo ʻoatu ʻa e ʻaloʻofá ʻi he feituʻu ʻoku ʻatā ai ʻe he mahinó ha feituʻu ki ai. ʻOku kau fakataha ʻa e taliui mo e manavaʻofá.
to.page.how.philosophy.p.totem-astrology-is: Totem Astrology 'oku langa ia 'i he 'amanaki — 'amanaki ke mahino lelei ange kiate koe, 'amanaki ke mahino 'a e kakai 'oku ke 'ofa ai, pea 'amanaki 'oku mo'oni 'a e fe'unga: 'oku 'i ai ha ngaahi hoa, ngaahi kaume'a, mo e kau mēmipa 'o e famili 'e lava ke nau fetaulaki mo koe 'i he feitu'u 'oku ke 'i ai. Ko e ngaahi fakahinohino monumanu ʻe faá ko ha lea vahevahe ia ki he ʻamanaki ko iá. ʻOku nau ʻomi ha meʻa fakalūkufua ke tau tuhu ki ai ʻi he taimi ʻoku ongoʻi veuveuki pe faingataʻa ke fakamatalaʻi ai ʻa e moʻui ʻi lotó.
to.page.how.four-guides.h2.your-four-totem-: Ko ho'o Ngaahi Fakahinohino Totem 'e Fa .
to.page.how.five-elements.h2.the-five-eleme: Ko e Ngaahi ʻElemēniti ʻe Nimá .
to.page.how.four-guides.p.totem-astrology-b: Totem Astrology langa 'i he Siaina Pou 'e fa 'o e iku'anga — ta'u fanau'i, mahina, 'aho, mo e houa. 'Oku fakahaa'i 'e he pou takitaha 'a e totem monumanu ally 'e taha: ho'o Laumalie, , Eeloto, mo e ngaahi fakahinohino. ʻOku nau faʻu fakataha ha pou totem ʻe taha — ko e tafaʻaki ʻe fā ʻo ha momeniti ʻo e fāʻeleʻi ʻe taha, ʻoku fakatoka mei he Sino ʻi he tuʻunga ʻo fakafou ʻi he Loto mo e ʻAtamai ki he Laumālie ʻoku fakakalauni ʻi ʻolunga.
to.page.how.yin-yang.p.yang-initiates-exten: ʻOku kamataʻi, fakalahi, mo fakapapauʻi ʻe Yang — ʻo ʻunu ki tuʻa ki he māmani ʻoku hā maí. ʻOku maʻu ʻe he Yin, fakaloloto, mo fakakakato — ʻo tānaki ki loto ki he nonga mo e fakaleleiʻi. ‘Oku fakatou fefiofi ‘e ho’o totem pole, ka ‘oku ‘ikai ‘aupito ke liliu ‘a e polarity ‘o e monumanu takitaha.
to.page.how.yin-yang.p.before-rainbow-compa: Kimu'a pea toki hū 'a e ngaahi hoa 'o e Rainbow, ngaahi ha'i 'o e Shadow, pe ko ha fa'ahinga logic pairing ki he 'ata, Yin mo e Yang ko e ongo founga tefito 'oku nga'unu 'a e ivi. to.article.values.power-triangle.p.the-squi: Ko e fekau'aki 'a e Squirrel mo e Mafai ko e Seeker, 'oku ne fie ma'u ma'u pe ke ma'u ha me'a lahi ange, ka 'oku 'ikai 'i ha founga craven. Ko e Squirrel, ko e fuofua monumanu ia ʻo e sotiakí, ʻokú ne ʻi ha fekumi ke maʻu ʻa e mālohí. ʻOkú ne tuli ia ʻo tefito ʻi he ʻāʻā mo e tuʻunga fakasōsialé — ko hono tānaki ʻo e ʻatamaí, lau ʻa e tuʻunga fakahokohokó, pea mo e aʻu mai kimuʻa ʻi he feʻauhí. Ta'engata 'a e fie'ilo, 'oku ne tupulaki 'i he dynamics 'o e kulupu 'ikai koe'uhi he 'oku ne holi ki he cuddly belonging, ka koe'uhi ko e ngaahi netiueka 'oku nofo ai 'a e lelei: ko hai 'oku ne 'ilo'i 'a e me'a, ko hai 'oku ne pule'i 'a e hū, ko hai na'e 'uluaki kuikui 'i he taimi na'e paasi ai 'a e hawk 'i 'olunga.
to.article.values.power-triangle.p.they-can: 'E lava ke nau fu'u possessive, 'o e ngaahi 'ofa'anga, hoa ngaue, ngaahi poloseki, pe kau ngaue, ka 'oku ha'u mo e possessiveness ko ia ha tauhi fefeka mo ha faka'apa'apa pau ki he tu'unga lelei. to.article.values.security-triangle.p.as-th: Ko e fuofua monumanu ia ʻo e tafaʻaki tolu ʻo e Maluʻí, ko e Pafaló ʻa e Tokotaha Kumi ʻo e Maluʻí. ʻOku ʻuhinga ʻeni ki he ngāue, tukupā, mo e fakatapui ki ha meʻa ʻoku lava ke sio ki ai. ‘Oku ne ‘ilo’i ‘a e mahu’inga fakanatula ‘o e me’a ‘e lava ke uesia mo’oni mo falala fefeka ki ai, pea feinga ke fakatupu ‘a e fa’ahinga tu’uma’u ko ‘eni ‘i he’ene mo’ui ‘a’ana ma’anautolu ‘oku ne mateaki ki ai. ‘Oku kītaki ‘a e Pafaló, ‘o ne sai‘ia ange ‘i he founga mo e ngaahi founga tukufakaholo ‘oku ‘ahi‘ahi‘i mo ‘ahi‘ahi‘í. Ko e feinga tu‘uma‘ú ‘okú ne ‘omai ‘a e ngaahi ola tu‘uloa, ko ia ‘oku fakahoko ai ‘e he Pafaló ‘a e ngaahi ngāue na‘e mei tukuange ‘e he ni‘ihi kehé ‘i ha taimi fuoloa ki mu‘a.
to.article.values.security-triangle.h3.the-: Ko e Fīniki — Ko e Fakatuʻi .
to.article.values.inspiration-triangle.p.th: ʻOku tutu ʻa e Tafaʻaki Tolu ʻo e Ueʻi Fakalaumālié ʻi he fanga monumanu hono 3, 7, mo e 11 ʻo e sotiakí: ko e Taika, Hoosi, mo e Uolofí.

Ko e Taika, ko e Tu'i 'o e tafa'aki tolu ko 'eni, 'oku ne fakakakano'i 'a e Ue'i Fakalaumālie 'o fakanatula 'o hange ko e 'omi 'e ha ulo 'a e vela. Ko e fakaʻeiʻeikí, fakapapaú, mo e pau ngingila ʻo e meʻa ʻoku totonu ke hokó ʻoku ʻikai ko ha ngaahi meʻa ia ʻokú ne fakakikihiʻi — ʻoku nau ulo noa pē mei ai. ʻOku ongoʻi ʻe he niʻihi kehé ʻa e fakakaukau lelei tahá ʻi hono ʻaó kimuʻa pea toki leaʻaki ha foʻi lea ʻe taha: hiki hake, poleʻi, fakamanatu ʻe lava ke vela vela ange ʻa e moʻuí pea ʻuhinga lahi ange. 'Oku 'ikai ke tuli 'e he Taika 'a e Inspiration 'o fu'u lahi 'o hange ko e tu'u ko hono fakamo'oni mo'ui.
to.article.values.inspiration-triangle.h2.t: Ko e Tafaʻaki Tolu ʻo e Ueʻi Fakalaumālié .

Ko e Taika — Ko e Tuʻi .
to.article.values.security-triangle.p.they-: 'Oku nau lalahi 'i he ngaahi faka'ali'ali, pea 'ilo'i lelei 'a e mahu'inga 'o e ngaahi fōtunga. 'Oku fiefia 'a e Phoenix 'i he talitali, 'oatu, mo hono pule'i fakatupu 'o e 'atakai. ‘Oku nau ‘ilo‘i ko e ngaahi me‘a faka‘ofo‘ofá mo e ngaahi fakahāhā ‘o e tu‘unga leleí ‘oku fakatou fakafiemālie mo fakafiemālie ‘i he‘enau fakahoko fakaefakatātā ‘a e tala‘ofa ‘o e malu‘angá. Ko ha founga ia ʻo e mālohi ʻoku fakahaaʻi ʻo fakafou ʻi he tuʻumālie, ʻoku fakataumuʻa ki he hemisphere toʻomataʻu ʻo e ʻutó pea ʻoku ʻuhinga ia ke mahino ʻo fakafou ʻi hono fakahaaʻi kae ʻikai ko hono tala — neongo ʻoku ʻikai ke nau faʻa toumoua ke talaatu ʻa e founga pē ʻoku nau ongoʻí. Ko e fakakaukau ko e fanongonongo, fakahoko, fakamatala — tuku ia ki tu'a, fakahaa'i ia ki mamani, tuku ke 'iloa!
to.article.values.inspiration-triangle.p.th: Ko e kau malu‘i fefeka kinautolu ‘o e me‘a ‘oku nau tui ki aí, pea ko honau mafai ‘i he tu‘unga ko ení ‘oku ‘ikai ha veiveiua. Ko e kau maluʻi ʻo e ngaahi taumuʻá, ʻofaʻangá, mo e ngaahi vīsoné fakatouʻosi, ʻoku nau maluʻi ʻa e fakaʻofoʻofá mo e moʻoní ʻaki ha holi ʻoku ʻikai ke ne fakaʻauha ha fakalelei — ʻo ʻikai ʻaki ʻenau fie maʻu ʻa e mateakí, ka ʻaki ʻenau taki ʻo fakafou ʻi he sīpingá kae ʻoua kuo fili ʻa e niʻihi kehé ke nau muimui. ʻOku ʻuhinga ʻenau charisma fakanatulá naʻa mo e taimi ʻoku ʻikai ke nau pule fakaʻofisiale aí, ʻoku hehema ʻa e lokí ke orient takatakai ʻi heʻenau ongoʻi ʻo e meʻa ʻoku mahuʻingá. Ko e Tu'i 'o e tafa'aki tolu ko 'eni, 'Oku pukepuke 'e he Taika 'a e senitaa 'o e Ue'i Fakalaumālie 'aki 'a e malohi ta'e feinga, pea 'oku fakahoko lahi taha ia 'i he taimi 'oku 'oange ai 'e he mo'ui 'a e malava ke nau embody 'a e fakakaukau 'i he vakai kakato 'a e mamani.
to.article.values.inspiration-triangle.h3.t: Ko e Uolofi — Ko e Mage .
to.article.values.harmony-triangle.h2.the-h: Ko e Tafaʻaki Tolu ʻo e Feʻunga .
to.article.values.inspiration-triangle.p.th: Ko honau fetuʻutaki mo e Ueʻi Fakalaumālié ko e fetuʻutaki ia ʻa e tokotaha tuli mateakí, ʻo tohoakiʻi taʻengata ki he meʻa ʻe lava ke hokó kae ʻikai ko e meʻa ʻoku ʻi aí pē. ‘Oku nau passionate ki ha hala, ‘i he taimi ‘e ni‘ihi ‘oku nau fakahala‘i ‘a e fiefia ‘o e lelé ki he a‘u ki he taumu‘á tonu. Ka ko e taʻefiemālie tonu ko ʻení ko ʻenau meʻaʻofá ia: ʻoku nau ʻave ʻa e niʻihi kehé ʻi honau ʻaá, pea ʻe lava ʻe honau ivi pipihí ʻo fakaakeake ha ngaahi kulupu kakato ki heʻenau holi ʻoku teʻeki ke fakaʻaongaʻí. Ki he Hoosi, ko ha fakakaukau taʻe ʻi ai ha ngaue ʻoku ʻikai lava ke kātakiʻi — pea ko ia ʻoku nau lele, puna, mo taki mei muʻa.
to.article.values.inspiration-triangle.p.as: ʻI heʻene hoko ko e monumanu hono ua ʻo e tafaʻaki tolu ʻo e Ueʻi Fakalaumālié, ko e Hosí ʻa e Tokotaha Kumi ʻo e Ueʻi Fakalaumālié. ʻOku ʻuhinga ʻeni ki ha fiekaia taʻefiemālie ki he ʻataá ʻoku ʻatā —ki he ʻotu ʻoku hokó, ʻa e malava hokó, ʻa e sio nounou ki he meʻa ʻe lava ke hoko ʻi he moʻuí kapau ʻe lele pē ha taha ki ai. ‘Oku ‘ikai ke faka‘ofo‘ofa‘ia pē ‘a e Hosí ‘i he ngaahi fakakaukau faka‘ei‘eikí mei he mama‘ó; ‘okú ne lele fakavave atu kiate kinautolu. Ko e tauʻatāiná ko hono paʻangá ia, pea ko e matangí ʻi hono ʻulú ko e ongo ʻo e fakapapaú ʻiate ia pē. ʻI he taimi ʻoku puke ai ʻe ha meʻa ʻene fakakaukaú, ʻoku puna ʻa e meʻamoʻuí kotoa ki muʻa: ʻoku tukituki ʻa e ngaahi vaʻé, ʻoku lahi ʻa e ngaahi ongoʻí, ʻoku tuku ʻa e māmani fakamāmaní ʻi ha ʻao ʻo e efu mo e talaʻofa.
to.article.values.inspiration-triangle.p.th: Ko e Uolofí, ko e monumanu hono tolu mo fakaʻosi ʻi he kulupú ni, ʻokú ne fakahaaʻi ʻa e Ueʻi Fakalaumālié ko e Mage. ʻI hono kamataʻi ʻo e ngaahi misiteli loloto ange ʻo e meʻa ʻoku totongi moʻoni ʻe he ngaahi fakakaukau fakaʻeiʻeikí mo e ʻuhinga moʻoní, ʻoku mahino ki he Uolofí ʻoku ʻikai ke leʻolahi pe ʻasi maʻu pē ʻa e Ueʻi Fakalaumālié. Taimi ʻe niʻihi ʻoku ngaʻunu ia ʻi he mateakí, ʻi he paá, ʻi he ngaahi hiva ʻoku hivaʻi ʻi he fakapoʻulí mo e ngaahi palani ʻoku fakatoka ʻi he fakalongolongó. ʻOku nau ʻiloʻi ʻa e founga ke fafangaʻi ʻaki ʻa e ulo ʻo e afí ʻo ʻikai vela ʻa e māmaní.
to.article.values.harmony-triangle.p.the-ha: ʻOku fakahaaʻi ʻa e Tafaʻaki Tolu ʻo e Feongoongoí ʻo fakafou ʻi he fanga monumanu hono 4, 8, mo e 12 ʻo e sotiakí: ko e Pusí, ko e Tiá, mo e Peá.
to.article.values.harmony-triangle.p.the-ca: Ko e Pusi, ko e Mage 'o e tafa'aki tolu ko 'eni, 'oku mahino kiate ia 'a e Harmony 'i he founga 'oku mahino ai ki ha pusi ha huelo 'o e la'a — 'ikai 'i hono 'analaiso ia, ka 'i he nofo ki ai 'aki 'a e instinct haohaoa. Vaʻinga, quirky, mo uncannily monūʻia, ʻoku nau fakatahaʻi ʻa e melie mo e sharpness ʻi he meʻafua tatau, ʻiloʻi pau ʻa e taimi ke fakamolū ai ha loki mo e taimi ke ulo ai ha claw. ʻOku puna vave ʻenau tokangá ʻo hangē pē ko kinautolú, pea ʻi heʻenau puna takitaha ʻoku nau fakatonutonu ʻa e ʻea fakaelotó ʻo meimei ʻikai ke fakatokangaʻi ʻe ha taha ʻa e founga naʻe hoko aí.
to.article.values.inspiration-triangle.p.wo: Ko e kau ulofí ko e kau fakakaukau fakatuʻupakē. ʻOku nau lava ʻo ongoʻi pe ko e fē ʻa e ngaahi vīsone ʻe kātakí pea ko e fē ʻe vela ʻo ʻosi, pea ʻoku nau ʻinivesi ʻo fakatatau ki ai — ʻi he kakaí, ʻi he ngaahi taumuʻá, ʻi he pō lōloa kimuʻa pea mafoa ʻa e atá. Ko honau ueʻi fakalaumālié ʻoku fekauʻaki mo vao, ʻoku aka ʻi he kau ka ʻoku ʻikai ke nau manavasiʻi ki he tafaʻaki taʻefakaʻauhá. Mahalo pē ‘oku ‘ikai ko kinautolu ‘a e ‘uluaki fanongonongo ‘o e misí, ka ‘oku fa‘a hoko kinautolu ko e fa‘ahinga ‘oku nau tauhi ia ke mo‘ui ‘i he taimi kuo mole ai ‘a e loto-to‘a ‘a e ni‘ihi kehé. ʻI heʻene hoko ko e Mage ʻo e tafaʻaki tolu ko ʻení, ʻoku ʻasi mai ʻa e Uolofí ʻi he taimi ʻe niʻihi ʻoku ʻaonga pē pe leʻohi, ka ʻi lalo ʻi he meʻa ko iá ʻoku ʻi ai ha mateaki ki he fakakaukau ʻoku fefeka mo tuʻuloa ʻo hangē ko e faʻahitaʻu momokó tonu.
to.article.values.harmony-triangle.p.as-the: Ko e monumanu hono ua ʻo e tafaʻaki tolu ʻo e Feongoongoí, ko e Tiá ʻa e Tokotaha Kumi ʻo e Feongoongoí. Ko e Tia Fakamisiteli — ngaahi misiteli na'a mo kinautolu. ʻOku ngali kehe ha meʻa fekauʻaki mo kinautolu: ʻoku fakaʻofoʻofa ka ʻoku kehe, ʻo hangē ʻoku ʻi ai pē honau vaʻe ʻe taha ʻi he tafaʻaki ko ʻení pea ʻoku kei kumi ʻe he taha ʻe tahá ha feituʻu ʻoku molū ange, fakalongolongo ange, mo nonga ange. ʻOku tohoakiʻi taʻengata kinautolu ki he melinó ʻo ʻikai ko ha taumuʻa pau ka ko ha ongoʻi totonu ʻoku ongoʻi, ko ha palanisi ʻoku ʻi he tafaʻaki pē ʻo e laine ʻakaú ʻa ia ʻoku nau meimei lava ʻo ʻahiʻahiʻi ka ʻoku ʻikai ke nau teitei pukepuke.
to.article.values.harmony-triangle.h3.the-c: Ko e Pusi — Ko e Mage .
to.article.values.harmony-triangle.h3.the-d: Ko e Tia — Ko e Tokotaha Kumi .
to.article.values.harmony-triangle.p.cats-d: ‘Oku ‘ikai ke malanga‘i ‘e he fanga pusí ‘a e melinó; ‘oku nau ‘enisinia‘i ia. Ko ha purr taimi lelei, ko ha fakahohaʻa fakakata, ko ha liliu fakafokifā ʻo e kaveingá ʻoku fakahoko ʻaki ha fakaʻofoʻofa ʻoku ʻikai pē ha feituʻu ke tūʻuta ai ʻa e ʻitá — ko ʻenau ngaahi meʻangāué ʻeni. Ko e kau pule kinautolu ʻo e paʻanga maʻamaʻá, ʻo fakafoki mai ʻa e palanisi ʻo fakafou ʻi he ʻatamai potó kae ʻikai ko e mamafá, pea ko ʻenau meʻaʻofá ke ʻai ʻa e feongoongoí ke ongoʻi taʻe-feinga neongo ʻoku fuʻu poto moʻoni ʻa e ngāue ʻi mui aí. Ko e Mage 'o e tafa'aki tolu ko 'eni, 'Oku 'asi mai 'a e Pusi 'i he taimi 'e ni'ihi 'oku mahu'inga'ia pe 'iate ia pe aloof, ka 'i lalo 'i he me'a ko ia 'oku 'i ai ha attunement loloto ki he mood 'o e kulupu mo ha mateaki fakalongolongo ke tauhi ia ke kakato.
to.article.values.harmony-triangle.p.their-: Ko honau fetuʻutaki mo e Harmony ko e fetuʻutaki ia ʻa e tokotaha tuli anga-malū, ʻoku ne fakafeʻungaʻi taʻengata ʻa e taʻefemahinoʻakí mo e holi ke fakafoki mai ʻa e meʻa kuo tō mei he tuʻunga totonú. ʻOku nau ongoʻi ha fehalaaki, ʻi he taimi ʻe niʻihi ʻoku nau puli atu ki honau fonua ʻi lotó ʻi he taimi ʻoku fuʻu fefeka ai ʻa e māmani ʻi tuʻá, ka ko e ongoʻi tonu ko ʻení ko ʻenau meʻaʻofá ia: ʻoku nau fakatokangaʻi ʻa e meʻa ʻoku misi ki ai ʻa e niʻihi kehé — ʻa e kiʻi tenge ʻi ha leʻo, ʻa e feongoongoi ʻe lava ke foki mai kapau naʻe ʻi ai ha taha pē ʻe maʻu ʻe he kātaki ke tatali ki aí. Ki he Tiá, ‘oku taau ke kumi ki he melinó na‘a mo e taimi ‘oku fakamo‘oni‘i ai ‘oku ‘ikai ke ma‘ú, pea ‘oku fa‘a ‘omai ‘e he‘enau kītaki fakalongolongó ‘a e nonga ki he ngaahi loki na‘e ‘ikai te nau ‘ilo‘i ‘oku nau ta‘efiemālié.
to.article.values.harmony-triangle.p.the-be: Ko e Pea, ko e Tu'i 'o e tafa'aki tolu ko 'eni, 'oku ne fakakakano'i 'a e Harmony 'o hange ko e fakanatula 'o e 'omi 'e ha afi 'a e mafana. Ko e Pea Lahi — mo e tōʻonga fakafiefia ʻo e kumi ʻa e ipu koulá ʻi he ngataʻanga ʻo e ʻuhila, fiefia ʻi he hone ʻi lotó, pea vahevahe ia mo kinautolu kotoa ʻoku nau ʻofa taha aí. Kiate kinautolu, ko e melinó mo e lahi ‘o e me‘akaí ko e anga pē ia ‘oku totonu ke ongo‘i ‘e he mo‘uí, pea ko ‘enau ‘i ai nima-homó ‘okú ne ‘ai ia ke pehē. ʻOku nofo ha niʻihi ʻi honau kautaha ʻo ʻikai kole ange, ʻo hangē ʻoku manatuʻi ʻe ha konga motuʻa ʻo e laumālié ʻoku ʻi heni, ʻi he fakaʻosí, ʻoku feʻunga.
to.article.values.harmony-triangle.h3.the-b: Ko e Pea — Ko e Fakatu'i .
to.article.values.harmony-triangle.p.they-a: Ko e kau maluʻi kinautolu ʻo e moʻui leleí, ʻo ʻikai ʻi he fakamālohí ka ʻi he lahi ʻo e meʻakaí. Ko ha tēpile fonu, ko ha ʻana talitali, ko ha loto fiemālie ke tuku pē ʻa e ngaahi ʻofaʻangá — ko e ngaahi founga ʻeni ʻoku pule ai ʻa e Peá. ʻOku mahino kiate kinautolu ʻoku ʻikai ko e feongoongoi moʻoní ʻa e ʻikai ha faingataʻá ka ko e ʻi ai ha hūfangaʻanga: ko ha feituʻu ʻe lava ke ʻahiʻahiʻi ai ʻa e fiefiá, mālōlō, pea lava ke paasi holo ʻa e melié ʻo ʻikai ha taʻeʻaonga pe tuʻunga. ʻI heʻene hoko ko e Tuʻi ʻo e tafaʻaki tolu ko ʻení, ʻoku maʻu ʻe he Peá ʻa e senitā ʻo e Feongoongoí ʻaki ha mafai taʻefakavavevave, pea ʻoku fakahoko lahi taha ia ʻi he taimi ʻoku ʻoatu ai ʻe honau māmaní ha feituʻu ke tānaki, fafangaʻi, mo vahevahe.
to.article.values.rainbow-companions.p.hidd: Fufū ʻi loto ʻi he sotiakí ʻo hangē ha taiamoní, ʻoku fakatahaʻi ʻe he ngaahi hoa ʻo e ʻUhila ʻe ono ʻa e fanga monumanu Yin mo Yang ʻi ha fengāueʻaki fakafetongi. ʻOku fakapalanisi ʻe he hoa takitaha ʻa e ngaahi mālohi ʻi lotó mo tuʻá — ʻoku hehema ʻa e taha ke taki ʻi he māmaní, ʻoku hehema ʻa e taha ke fakaloloto, fakamolū, pe fakakakato ʻa e meʻa ʻoku kamataʻi ʻe he ʻuluakí. ‘I he taimi ‘oku na fakatou ‘asi mai ai ‘i ha totem pole ‘o ha taha, pe ‘i ha feohi vāofi, ‘oku na fa’a ma’u ‘iate kinaua ha fakafepaki fakanatula.
to.article.values.shadow-companions.p.each-: 'Oku 'i ai foki mo e monumanu takitaha ha hoa 'o e 'Alu'alu — 'a e inverse 'o hono fehokotaki'anga 'o e Rainbow. ‘I he feitu’u ‘oku to’o mai ai ‘e he ‘Uha-‘Uha ‘a e ngaahi lanu mo’oni ‘o ha taha ‘o fakafou ‘i he maama, ‘oku fakapo’uli ‘a e ‘Alu’alu ‘o fakamakinito, ‘o fakahaa’i ‘a e ngaahi hala ‘aki ‘a e mahino haohaoa (ko e lelei ange kotoa ke fakalelei’i kinautolu!). Ko e ongo ha‘í fakatou‘osi ‘oku mātu‘aki fakamakinito; ko e kehekehe 'oku fakahaa'i 'e he 'Uha 'a e me'a 'oku 'osi ulo, ka 'oku fakahaa'i 'e he 'Alu'alu 'a e me'a kuo pau ke fehangahangai mo ngaue ki ai. ʻOku tau fie maʻu moʻoni fakatouʻosi ʻi he māmani ko ʻení, pea ko ia ʻoku faʻa tohoakiʻi ai kitautolu ki he ongo meʻá ni! ‘Oku ‘ikai ha hao mei he ‘Alu’alu ‘o ha taha: ‘oku ne ‘omai ‘a e me’a’ofa pole ‘o hono fakahaa’i mahino ‘a e ngaahi fehalaaki mo e ngaahi faikehekehe, koe’uhi ke lava ‘o ngaue’i kinautolu kae ‘ikai ke faka’ehi’ehi mei ai.
to.article.values.h2.the-dragon-the-cat-two: Ko e Talakoni & Ko e Pusi — Lens kehekehe 'e ua 'i he Fili tatau .
to.article.values.p.meanwhile-the-dragon-ca: Lolotonga iá, ʻe lava ʻe he Talakoní ʻo tokangaʻi ha faʻahinga malumalu pau ʻoku lī ʻe kinautolu kuo fakaʻauʻauhifo honau fulufuluʻi manú ʻe heʻene ngaahi ngāué, ʻo ne tali ʻa e ngaahi fakamoveuveu fakataimi ʻo e melinó ko e fakamole ʻi he taimi ʻe niʻihi ʻo hono tuli ʻene ngaahi taumuʻá. ‘Okú ne vēkeveke ke fakahoko ‘a e ngaahi taumu‘a ko iá pea ‘okú ne hanganaki sio fakamama‘u ki he palé, lolotonga ia ‘e ‘ilo‘i ‘e he Pusí ‘oku lahi ange ‘ene loto-mamahi ‘i he ngaahi ongo‘i fakafili ‘i he kulupú.
to.article.values.p.neither-animal-welcomes: ʻOku ʻikai talitali ʻe ha taha ʻo e ongo manú ha ongoongo kuo maumau pe ko hono fakamoveuveuʻi ʻo e feongoongoí, ka ʻi he taimi ʻoku fakamālohiʻi ai ke na fili ʻa e taha pe ko e tahá te na hehema ke fai ha ngaahi fili kehekehe ʻo makatuʻunga ʻi he ngaahi tuʻunga mahuʻinga ʻokú na fakamuʻomuʻá.
to.article.values.p.the-cat-has-a-relativel: Ko e Pusi 'oku 'i ai 'ene kataki 'oku 'ikai fu'u ma'olunga ange ki he mole 'o e momeniti 'o e ngeia, 'oku lava ke ne lulululu ia 'o 'alu pea pounce 'o 'alu mo e 'ulu 'oku pukepuke ma'olunga 'o hange 'oku 'ikai ha me'a na'e hoko. 'Oku vēkeveke ia ke foki ki he melino mo e palanisi, lolotonga ia 'e mo'ua 'a e ki'i me'a tatau ke tauhi ha Talakoni 'i he po'uli, stewing 'i he mole 'o e fofonga.
to.article.values.p.the-dragon-may-thus-cho: Ko ia ai, ‘e fili nai ‘e he Talakoní ha founga ngāue ‘oku fehangahangai ange ke ne utu ‘a e ngaahi ‘aonga ‘i he mala‘e ‘o e Mālohí mo e Langilangí, lolotonga ia ‘e fili nai ‘e he Pusí ha founga fakapotopoto ange, ‘o ne kumi ‘i hono kehé ke tauhi ‘a ‘ene Melino mo e Fe‘ofo‘ofani.
to.article.values.p.for-example-the-dragon-: Hangē ko ʻení, ʻoku ʻi he Tafaʻaki Tolu ʻo e Mālohí ʻa e Talakoní. Ko hono 'uhinga 'oku ne hehema ke fakamaau'i 'a e ngaahi me'a 'o makatu'unga 'i he founga 'e uesia ai hono malohi. Ko e Pusi 'oku 'i he Harmony Triangle, ko ia 'oku ne hehema ke fakamaau'i 'a e ngaahi me'a 'o makatu'unga 'i he founga 'e uesia ai 'ene melino. 'I he taimi 'oku fakapapau'i ai 'i he vaha'a 'o e ngaahi founga kehe 'o e ngaue, 'e hehema 'a e Talakoni ke fokotu'u ha mamafa lahi ange ki he ngaahi nunu'a ki hono ongoongo, lolotonga ia 'e hoha'a lahi ange 'a e Pusi pe 'oku 'i he tu'unga fakatu'utamaki 'a hono fe'ofo'ofani pe 'ikai.
to.article.fourGuides.p.totem-astrology-bui: Totem Astrology langa 'i he Siaina Pou 'e fa 'o e iku'anga — ta'u fanau'i, mahina, 'aho, mo e houa. 'Oku fakahaa'i 'e he pou takitaha 'a e totem monumanu ally 'e taha: ho'o Laumalie, , Eeloto, mo e ngaahi fakahinohino.
to.article.fourGuides.p.spirit-mind-heart-a: Laumālie, ʻAtamai, Loto, mo e Sino — ko ha ngaahi kaumeʻa monumanu ʻe fā ʻoku fakatoka ʻi hoʻo pou totem, ʻo fakahaaʻi ʻo fakafou ʻi he Pou ʻe Fā ʻo hoʻo ʻaloʻí.
to.article.values.h2.discover-your-four-ani: ʻIloʻi Hoʻo Ngaahi Fakahinohino ki he Monumanu ʻe Fā .
to.article.values.p.use-the-free-calculator: Faka'aonga'i 'a e me'a fakafuofua ta'etotongi ke fakahaa'i ho'o fanga monumanu totem Fakalaumalie, Faka'atamai, Fakaeloto, mo Fakasino — pea fakatotolo'i 'a e founga 'oku fa'u ai 'e honau ngaahi tafa'aki tolu 'o e ngaahi mahu'inga ho mamani 'i loto.
to.article.values.p.neither-is-right-or-wro: 'Oku 'ikai ke tonu pe hala 'a e taha, pea 'oku 'i ai 'a e ongo founga 'oku 'i ai hona ngaahi malohinga mo e ngaahi vaivai'anga — ko e me'a fakaofo 'eni 'o e fehokotaki'anga 'o e 'Alu'alu, koe'uhi he 'oku ne faka'ilonga'i 'a e ngaahi faikehekehe ko 'eni 'a ia ka 'ikai te tau ta'etokanga'i kinautolu pe fakakaukau 'oku “fai hala” pe 'a e kakai kehe :)
to.article.fourGuides.p.the-year-pillar-spe: ʻOku lea ʻa e pou ʻo e taʻú ki hoʻo tuʻunga fakalaumālié — ʻa e ʻā ʻo e tokotaha ʻokú ke hoko ki aí ʻi ha moʻui. ʻOku faʻu ʻe he pou māhiná ʻa e founga ʻokú ke fakakaukau mo fakahoko ai ʻa e māmaní. ʻOku aʻu atu ʻa e pou ʻahó ki he lotó — ʻa e anga ʻo hoʻo ongoʻí, fekauʻakí, mo e filí ʻi he fale faiva vāofi ʻo e moʻui fakaʻahó. Ko e pou houa 'oku ne fakava'e 'a e sino — instinct, stamina, mo e 'uhinga fakasino 'oku ke nga'unu 'i he mamani mo ia.
to.article.fourGuides.h2.meet-your-four-gui: Fetaulaki mo Ho'o Kau Fakahinohino 'e Fa .
to.article.elements.p.water-wood-fire-earth: Vai, ʻAkau, Afi, Māmani, mo e Ukamea — ʻoku fakahoa ʻe he konga takitaha ʻo hoʻo pou totem ha monumanu mo e taha ʻo e ngaahi ʻElemēniti ʻe Nima ko ʻení, ʻo tānaki atu ha laʻi pau ʻo e texture ki hoʻo ngaahi fakahinohino monumanu Laumālie, ʻAtamai, Loto, mo e Sino. 'E lava foki ke fakakaukau'i 'a e ngaahi 'elemeniti 'e nima ko e ngaahi sipinga 'e nima ki he ngaue 'a e ivi — takitaha mo hono fakahinohino, logic, mo e Yin & Yang fakahaa'i.
to.article.fourGuides.p.enter-your-birth-da: Fakahu ho 'aho fanau'i, taimi, mo e kolo 'i he Totem Animals Calculator. Hili e 'asi mai ho'o pou totem, click ha fa'ahinga kaati monumanu ke lau ha fakahinohino fakaikiiki fekau'aki mo e totem ko ia, hono 'elemeniti, mo hono tu'unga Yin pe Yang.
to.article.fourGuides.p.picture-them-stacke: Fakakaukauloto atu kiate kinautolu ʻoku nau fakatoka ʻo hangē ha pou totem — Sino ʻi he tuʻunga, Loto ʻi ʻolunga, ʻAtamai hoko atu, pea Laumālie ʻoku fakakalauni ʻi ʻolunga. ‘I hono fakataha‘í, ko e fanga monumanu ‘e fā ko ení ‘oku ‘ikai ko ha ngaahi horoscope kehekehe ‘e fā ‘oku fakapipiki fakataha. Ko e totem pole ‘e taha kinautolu — ko e tafa’aki ‘e fā ‘o ha momeniti ‘e taha ‘o e fanau’i, ‘oku takitaha ‘i ai ‘ene ‘elemeniti pea mo e polarity tu’u ma’u ‘a e monumanu ko ia ko e Yin pe Yang.
to.article.fourGuides.p.enter-your-birth-de: Fakahu ho'o ngaahi fakaikiiki 'o e fanau'i ke fakahaa'i 'a e fanga monumanu 'i ho'o totem pole.
to.article.elements.p.water-wood-fire-earth: Vai, 'Akau, Afi, Mamani, mo e Ukamea — ngaahi sipinga 'e nima ki he founga 'oku nga'unu ai 'a e ivi 'i ho'o pou totem .
to.article.elements.figcaption.generating-c:

to.article.elements.p.in-chinese-cosmology-: ‘I he cosmology faka-Siaina ‘oku nau nga’unu ‘i ha siakale hokohoko: ‘Oku fafanga ‘e he vai ‘a hono ivi fakatupu ivi ki he ‘Akau koe’uhi ke ne lava ‘o tupulaki ‘a hono ngaahi fa’unga lahi, pea ‘oku ‘omai leva ‘e he ngaahi va’a mo e lau ‘o e ‘Akau ‘a e lolo ki he fōnise ‘o e liliu ‘o e Afi, ‘a ia ‘oku ne fakatupu ‘a e efu mo e emberness ‘oku nau nofo ke hoko ko e Mamani mo e Metsure emboes be, pea ‘oku kei hoko ‘a e Mamani ‘o e embo e fakatupu 'a e Crystals, 'a ia 'i he'ene hoko 'oku ne 'omi 'a e ngaahi feitu'u haohaoa ki he Vai ke condense mo tafe ke kamata fo'ou 'a e siakale.
to.article.elements.p.on-your-calculator-re: ‘I ho’o ngaahi ola ‘o e calculator, ‘oku ‘asi ‘a e ‘elemeniti takitaha ‘o e fakahinohino ‘i hono kaati. Lomi'i ha fa'ahinga monumanu ke lau 'a e founga 'oku fakataha'i ai 'a e 'elemeniti ko ia mo e polarity 'i ho'o pou totem.
to.article.elements.p.water-brings-everythi: ʻOku ʻomi ʻe he vaí ʻa e meʻa kotoa pē ki loto pea fakaʻaongaʻi ia ki lalo. Te ke lava ʻo sio mahino taha ki he meʻá ni ʻi he topography ʻo ha vai — ʻi he ʻuluaki taimí ʻoku haʻu ʻa e vaí ʻo tafe hifo mei he ngaahi feituʻu māʻolunga ʻi he tafaʻaki kotoa pē ke tānaki ʻi he lotomālié pea hoko ko ha vaitafe. ‘Oku matangi leva ‘a e vaitafé ‘o ‘alu hifo mo takai holo kae ‘oua kuo faifai pea na‘a mo ia ‘e a‘u nai ki ha feitu‘u ‘okú ne fai ai ha tō lahi pea hoko ko ha vaitō! Ko e ivi kotoa ko iá na‘e ‘alu hifo ia mei he ngaahi mā‘olunga ‘o e ngaahi mo‘ungá, ‘o ‘alu hifo ki he tele‘á, ‘o ‘alu hifo ‘i ai mei he ngaahi tafa‘aki lahi kae ‘oua kuo fakatahataha‘i hifo ‘a e ngaahi va‘a kotoa ko iá ‘o hoko ko ha taha pē, pea ‘oku tō hifo ‘a e taha ko iá ‘i he tafa‘akí ke tō hifo ‘i ha loloto lahi ange ‘i lalo, ‘o ‘omai ai ‘a e vaí ki lalo ki he ma‘u‘anga ‘o e kalāvité.
to.article.elements.p.wood-starts-as-a-seed: ʻOku kamata ʻa e ʻakaú ko ha tengaʻi ʻakau ʻi he lotomālié pea ʻoku vaʻa leva ia ʻi ha ongo tafaʻaki fehangahangai — ʻokú ne fekauʻi atu ha aka ʻoku tō hifo ki he kelekelé lolotonga ia ʻoku tupu ʻi he taimi tatau ha ʻakau ʻo ʻalu hake ʻo fakahangatonu ki he laʻaá. ‘Oku puna mai hono ‘uluaki laú ke tānaki ‘a e ivi mei ‘olunga lolotonga ia ‘oku fakalahi atu ‘a hono ‘uluaki taproot ke ne mimisi ‘a e vaí mo e ngaahi minerale mei laló. Mei ai, 'oku ne kei branching 'a e fractally, 'o fakapalanisi ma'u pe 'a e tupu fo'ou 'i 'olunga 'i he funga mo e ngaahi fekumi loloto 'i lalofonua. ʻOku kei mavahevahe pē ʻa e ngaahi aká mo vaʻa ʻi laló ʻo hangē pē ko e spiral ʻa e ngaahi vaʻá ki tuʻa pea kei tupu pē ha ngaahi vaʻa foʻou ʻi ʻolunga. ʻOku ʻalu ʻa e ngaʻunu mei he lotomālié ʻo ʻalu atu ki tuʻa, ʻo vaʻa mo spiraling ʻi he ngaahi tafaʻaki kotoa pē ʻe ala lavá.
to.article.elements.p.in-its-yin-form-water: 'I hono fotunga Yin, 'Oku hange 'a e Vai ha vaitafe, 'a e kakapu, pe 'uha — malimali mo fa'a kataki, seeping ki he mafesifesi kotoa pe pea kumi 'a e hala 'o e si'isi'i taha 'o e fakafepaki kae 'ikai ko hono fakamālohi'i hono hala 'o fou atu. Yin Vai fafanga fakalongolongo, fakatahataha 'i he ngaahi feitu'u fufuu pea tuku 'a e taimi ke ne fai 'a e ngaue 'o e tui 'o e maka 'oku 'ata'ata. ʻOku ʻikai fie maʻu ia ke ne fanongonongo ia; ‘okú ne kei tafe pē, ‘o fe‘ungamālie ki ha fa‘ahinga fōtunga pē ‘oku ‘omai ‘e he māmaní kae ‘oua kuo fakamolū mo fafanga‘i ‘a e me‘a kotoa pē ‘oku takatakai ‘iate iá. 'I hono fotunga Yang 'Oku hange ange 'a e Vai ko e 'oseni raging — coursing 'i loto mo tu'a mo e ngaahi peau, crashing 'a e ngaahi peau lalahi ki he ngaahi maka, 'o fai ha splash lahi. ʻOku lōmekina ʻe he Yang Water ʻa e meʻa ʻoku tuʻu ʻi muʻa aí, ʻo ne toe fakafōtunga ʻa e ʻotu motú ʻaki ha mālohi taʻetuku, ʻo ʻikai lava ke tukunoaʻi pe taʻofi ʻi he taimi pē ʻoku ngaʻunu ai hono mamafa kakató.
to.article.elements.p.inside-that-same-circ: ʻI loto ʻi he siakale tatau, ʻoku faʻu ai ʻe ha sīpinga hono ua ha pentakalami — ko e siakale puleʻí. 'Oku tauhi 'e he 'elemeniti takitaha 'a e taha 'i he sieke: 'E lava ke spray 'a e vai 'i he Afi ke ta'ofi ia mei he mavahe mei he nima, 'Oku vela 'a e Afi mo fakamolū 'a e Ukamea koe'uhi ke lava 'o ngaue'aki 'o faingofua ange, 'Oku motuhi 'e he Ukamea 'a e sharpness 'i he 'Akau ke prune 'o 'ave hono ngaahi me'a 'oku lahi ange, 'Oku piki 'a e ngaahi aka 'o e 'Akau ke pukepuke 'a e Mamani Earth E dact form fakataha mo e . ngaahi ve‘e vaitafé.
to.article.elements.p.in-its-yin-form-earth: ʻI hono fōtunga Yin, ʻoku hangē ʻa e Māmaní ha teleʻa — ʻoku ʻalu holo ʻa e ngaahi moʻunga ʻoku tafe malimali, ʻo talitali lelei ʻa e meʻa kotoa pē ʻo hifo ki he lotomālié, ʻo ʻoatu ʻa e kelekele foʻou ʻe lava ke pukepuke ai ʻe he ngaahi aka. Yin Earth ma'u mo pukepuke — ko ha tu'uta molumalu ki ha me'a pe 'oku to, kataki fe'unga ke tuku 'a e mo'ui ke aka mo tupulaki 'i ai 'o 'ikai fie ma'u ke fakapapau'i ia. ʻI hono fōtunga ʻo e Yang ʻoku hangē ange ia ha moʻunga — ngaahi pulou mālohi ʻo e ngaahi tumutumú, ʻoku kovi ʻi he taimi kotoa pē, ʻoku tuʻu loto-toʻa ʻi tuʻa ʻo fakafepakiʻi ʻa e fonuá, ʻoku ʻasi ki he matangí mo e ʻeá ka ʻokú ne pukepuke hono kelekelé ʻaki ʻa e tuʻu maʻu fakapapau ʻoku taʻo tonu ʻi loto. ‘okú ne fua ‘a e mamafa mei ‘olunga pea ‘okú ne taliteke‘i ‘a e holo ‘a e kelekelé, ‘o tu‘u ko ha poini fakafekau‘aki tu‘uma‘u lolotonga ia ‘oku hiki ‘a e me‘a kehe kotoa pē ‘o takatakai ‘iate ia.
to.article.elements.p.fire-can-be-seen-as-t: ‘E lava ke vakai ki he Afi ko e inverse ia ‘o e Vai — ‘a ia ‘oku fakahoko ai ‘e he Vai ‘a e ivi ki loto mo lalo, ‘oku liliu ia ‘e he Afi ‘aki ‘ene fekau’i atu ia ki tu’a mo ‘olunga. ‘Oku to‘o ‘e he afí ‘a e ngaahi fa‘unga ‘o e ‘Akau ‘oku ‘osi ‘i aí, mo honau ngaahi faingata‘á kotoa, pea ‘okú ne tutu kinautolu — ‘o ne tutu mo liliu kinautolu, ‘o ne pahū ‘a e ngaahi afi mo e ‘ea vela ki tu‘a mo ‘olunga ke fakatupu ha me‘a fo‘ou mei he faka‘auha kotoa pē: ko e vela, maama, mo e efu kohu ‘oku tō hifo pea iku ‘o hoko ko e Māmani ‘oku nofo‘í. ʻOku fakatauʻatāinaʻi ʻe he afí ʻa e ngaahi meʻá ʻi hono ʻāʻāá, ʻo ne tuku ha feituʻu ʻataʻatā lahi ʻa ia naʻe ʻi ai ha taimi naʻe ʻi ai ha fuʻu ʻakau ʻi lalo ʻoku lavelavea ʻo tupu matolu mo mamafa ʻi lalo heni kimuʻá. ‘Oku mafola atu ‘a e afí, ‘o tupu ma‘u pē ki tu‘a, ‘o kaka hake ma‘u pē, kae ‘oua kuo lī ‘e hono ulo‘i afí ‘a e langí tonu.
to.article.elements.p.in-its-yin-form-wood-: ‘I hono fotunga Yin, ‘Oku hangē ‘a e ‘Akaú ko ha fu‘u ‘akau pe ko ha fu‘u kālepi — ‘oku toe fe‘unu‘aki mo fe‘ungamālie ange, ka ‘oku falala lahi ange ia ki he ni‘ihi kehé, ‘oku hehema ke ne ngāue‘aki ha me‘a pē ‘oku takatakai ke tokoni ki he‘ene fekumi ki he māmá ‘i he‘ene kaka haké. He ʻikai ʻaupito ke motu ʻa Yin Wood ʻi ha afā — ʻe lava pē ke ne punou mo e ngaahi matangí. ʻI hono fōtunga ʻo e Yang ʻoku hangē ange ia ko ha ʻoke mālohi pe ʻakau kulokula — ʻoku fefeka mo fefeka ange, ka ʻoku tauʻatāina mo maluʻi, ʻoku māʻolunga ʻi he vaotaá pea ʻoatu ʻa e faʻunga, ʻuluʻakau, mo e maluʻanga kiate kinautolu ʻi laló. ʻE lava ke tuʻu mālohi ʻa e Yang Wood ʻi he ngaahi matangi siʻisiʻi angé, ka ʻe faifai pea naʻa mo e fuʻu ʻakau mālohi tahá ʻe motuhia ia ʻi he malumalu ʻo e ngaahi matangi mālohi mo tuʻuloa pe tenge.
to.article.elements.p.in-its-yin-form-fire-: ʻI hono fōtunga Yin, ʻoku hangē ange ʻa e Afí ko ha teʻelango pe ko ha maama — ʻoku molumalu, ʻoku ʻi ai, pea ʻoku fakatapui ke fakamaama ʻa e halá ke sio ai ʻa e kakaí. ʻOku ʻomi ʻe he Yin Fire ʻa e māfana ʻo ʻikai fie maʻu ʻa e fakaʻauhá; ‘okú ne fiema‘u ke tokanga‘i mo faka‘ai‘ai, ka ‘oku lava ke ne vela ma‘u pē ‘i ha pō lōloa, ‘o ne pukepuke ha ulo ‘e taha ‘o fakafepaki‘i ‘a e fakapo‘ulí. ‘Okú ne fakamaama kae ‘ikai faka‘auha, ‘o fakaafe‘i ‘a e fa‘ahinga ‘oku ofi maí ke nau ‘unu‘unu ofi ange. ʻI hono fōtunga Yang ʻoku hangē ange ia ko e Laʻaá pe ko ha afi ʻo e vaotaá — ʻoku vela vela mo vela ʻa e meʻa kotoa pē ʻi hono halá. ʻOku mafola ʻa e Yang Fire ʻo ʻikai ha kole, ʻo kaka maʻu pē ki ʻolunga mo tuʻa kae ʻoua kuo ʻikai ha meʻa ʻi hono aʻu ki aí ʻoku tuku taʻe liliu, ʻo ne fakamaʻa fakaʻaufuli ʻa e motuʻá koeʻuhí ke kamata ha meʻa foʻou fakaʻaufuli.
to.article.elements.p.earth-brings-everythi: ʻOku ʻomi ʻe he māmaní ʻa e meʻa kotoa pē ke mālōlō. Ko e taimi kuo ‘osi ai ‘a e vela ‘a e Afi, ‘oku ‘ikai ke kei ‘alu hake pe mafola ‘a e me’a ‘oku tō — ‘oku ne nofo. ʻOku tafe hifo ʻa e efuefu. Embers momoko. ʻOku kumi ʻe he efu ʻa e feituʻu māʻulalo tahá pea tuʻu. Te ke lava ʻo sio ki he meʻá ni ʻi he tafaʻaki kotoa ʻo e fonuá: ʻoku tō hifo ʻa e sediment ʻi he feituʻu ʻoku māmālie ai ha tāfeá, ʻoku fonu ʻa e kelekelé ʻi he laʻi ʻo e vaotā mo e ngoueʻanga kotoa pē, ʻoku puke maʻu pē ʻa e kelekele ʻi lalo ʻi ho vaʻé lolotonga ia ʻoku kei ngaʻunu pē ʻa e meʻa kehe kotoa pē ʻi ʻolunga aí. ʻOku tānaki ʻe he māmaní ʻa e mamafá, ʻo fakamālohiʻi hifo, pea nofo pē — ʻa e ngaʻunu ʻa e ivi ʻoku haʻu ke mālōlō ʻi he feituʻu tonu ʻokú ne ʻi aí, ʻo ne fua hifo ʻaki ha nonga ʻoku ʻikai fie maʻu ke ʻalu ki ha feituʻu.
to.article.elements.p.metal-also-thought-of: Ko e ukameá — ‘oku toe fakakaukau‘i ko e Crystal — ‘okú ne tānaki ‘a e me‘a kuo moveteveté pea toho ia ki loto ki ha tu‘unga pē ‘e taha. 'I he feitu'u 'oku va'a ai 'a e 'Akau ki tu'a mei ha tenga'i 'akau 'i he tafa'aki kotoa pe, 'Oku lele 'a e Ukamea 'a e sipinga 'i he fakafepaki: condensing matolu, 'omi, mo e maka mei he mamafa kei 'o e Mamani ki ha uho 'e taha kuo fakalelei'i. Te ke lava ʻo sio ki he meʻá ni ʻi he founga ʻoku smelted hifo ai ʻa e raw ore ki ha ingot maʻa, ʻa e founga ʻoku fuse ai ʻa e ʻoneʻoné mo e vela ki he sioʻata ʻoku ʻi ai ha tafaʻaki mahino ʻe taha, ʻa e founga ʻoku faʻu ai ha makakoloa ʻi he taimi ʻoku tekeʻi ai ʻe he mālohi mei he tafaʻaki kotoa pē ha lattice sioʻata ki he fōtunga ʻe taha ʻoku fie maʻu ʻe hono uho. Ko e ngaʻunu ʻoku ʻi loto pea ʻoku fakatefito — mei he tafaʻaki kotoa pē ʻo fakahangatonu ki he lotomālié tonu, ʻo fakapuliki kae ʻoua kuo ʻikai toe maumauʻi ha meʻa ʻi he fālahí.
to.article.yinYang.p.two-fundamental-ways-t: Founga tefito 'e ua 'oku nga'unu 'a e ivi — ta'o ki he monumanu totem takitaha mei he kamata'anga.
to.article.yinYang.p.before-rainbow-compani: Kimu'a pea toki hū 'a e ngaahi hoa 'o e Rainbow, ngaahi ha'i 'o e Shadow, pe ko ha fa'ahinga logic pairing ki he 'ata, Yin mo e Yang ko e ongo founga tefito 'oku nga'unu 'a e ivi. 'I he Totem Astrology, 'oku ta'o 'a e polarity ki he monumanu takitaha mei he kamata'anga — ko ha Squirrel 'oku Yang ma'u pe, ko ha Pafalo 'oku Yin ma'u pe, ko ha Taika 'oku Yang ma'u pe, ko ha Pusi 'oku Yin ma'u pe, pea pehe atu 'o fakafou 'i he toko hongofulu ma ua kotoa pe. ‘I ho’o ngaahi kaati fakafuofua ‘oku nau ‘asi mai ko e Yang (+) pe Yin (−) ‘i he tafa’aki ‘o e ‘elemeniti ‘o e monumanu ko ia.
to.article.elements.p.in-its-yin-form-metal: 'I hono fotunga Yin, 'Oku hange 'a e ukamea ha sio'ata, ha taimani, pe siueli lelei — 'a e 'omi mei he tafa'aki kotoa pe 'o fakamālohi'i 'a e me'a ki ha configuration haohaoa 'e taha, translucent mo tonu, 'o pukepuke hono fotunga 'o 'ikai fie ma'u ke motuhi pe mafola. 'Oku fakatefito 'e he Yin Metal 'a e faka'ofo'ofa mo e mahu'inga ki loto, 'o 'oatu 'a e fakalelei'i mo e mahino kiate kinautolu 'oku nau fakahounga'i ia kae 'ikai ke striking 'iate ia pe. ʻI hono fotunga ʻo e Yang ʻoku hangē ange ia ha mataʻi heletā pe ko ha heletā — ko e matolu kotoa ko ia ʻoku faile ʻo toe māsila ange ʻo aʻu ki ha tafaʻaki ʻo e hele-manifinifi, fakaleleiʻi ke slice ʻi he ʻeá ʻaki ʻa e faingofua taha, ʻo vēkeveke ke motuhi hono halá ʻo ofi ange ki he taumuʻá. Yang Metal vahevahe, fakamavahe'i fakapapau 'a e me'a 'oku 'a'ana mei he me'a 'oku 'ikai, pea 'e 'ikai ke ne toumoua ke tuki 'i he fakafe'atungia'i 'i he taimi 'oku fie ma'u ai 'e he momeniti.
to.article.yinYang.p.squirrel-tiger-dragon-: Sikili, Taika, Talakoni, Hoosi, Manuki, mo e Wolf — ko e fanga monumanu Yang 'e ono, 'oku nau 'asi ma'u pe ki tu'a 'i honau natula mahu'inga.
to.article.yinYang.h3.yang-the-outward-curr: Yang — ko e lolotonga ki tu'a .
to.article.yinYang.p.buffalo-cat-snake-deer: Pafalo, Pusi, Ngata, Tia, Fīniki, mo e Bear — ko e fanga monumanu Yin ʻe ono, ʻoku nau ʻi loto maʻu pē ʻi honau natula mahuʻingá.
to.article.yinYang.p.yang-is-not-recklessne: ʻOku ʻikai ko ha taʻefakakaukau ʻa Yang, neongo ʻe lava ke hoko ʻa Yang ʻoku ʻikai ke siviʻí ko e meʻa ko iá. ʻI hono tuʻunga lelei tahá ko e loto-toʻa, mahino, mo e loto fiemālie ke sio ki ai. ʻOkú ne langa, tataki, maluʻi ʻi tuʻa, pea ʻomi ʻa e vela mo e ivi. Fakakaukau ki he maama ʻo e laʻaá ʻi he kelekele ʻataʻataá — ʻokú ne fakamaamaʻi, fakamāfanaʻi, tohoakiʻi hake ʻa e moʻuí ki he fukahi tahí.
to.article.yinYang.p.they-are-not-good-and-: ʻOku ʻikai ke nau “lelei” mo “kovi,” pea ʻoku ʻikai ke nau fakapapauʻi ʻa e tangata mo e fefine. Ko e ngaahi founga fakakakato kinautolu — ko e ongo vaeua ʻo ha meʻa kakato ʻoku nau fie maʻu ke nau nofo palanisi.
to.article.yinYang.h3.yin-the-inward-curren: Yin — ko e lolotonga 'o e loto .
to.article.yinYang.p.yin-is-the-quality-of-: Ko e Yin ko e tu'unga lelei ia 'o e ma'u, fakaloloto, mo e fakakakato. ‘Oku nga‘unu ia ki loto. ʻOku tānaki, pukepuke, fanongo, mo fakaleleiʻi ʻe he ivi ʻo e Yin. ʻOku hehema ia ki he fakalongolongó, tali leleí, mo e tākiekina fakapulipulí —ko e konga ʻo koe ʻokú ne toʻo ʻa e meʻa ʻoku hokó, tauhi ʻa e meʻa kuo kamataʻí, pea ʻiloʻi ʻa e taimi ke tatali aí kae ʻikai ko e fakamālohí.
to.article.yinYang.p.yang-is-the-quality-of: Yang ko e tu'unga lelei 'o e ZZTAG0ZKamata, fakalahi, mo e fakapapau'i. ʻOkú ne ngaʻunu atu ki he māmani ʻoku hā maí. ʻOku ngāue ʻa e ivi ʻo e Yang, fakahā, teke ki muʻa, pea ʻai ke ʻiloʻi ia. ʻOku hehema ia ki he ngingilá, ʻekitivitií, mo e fakahaaʻi fakahangatonú — ʻa e konga ʻo koe ʻokú ne laka atu, toʻo ʻa e fatongiá, kamata ʻa e fetalanoaʻakí, pe ʻai ha fakakaukau ke ngaue kimuʻa pea toki motuʻa kakató.
to.article.yinYang.p.neither-pole-is-comple: ʻOku ʻikai kakato ha taha ʻo e ongo poú taʻekau ai ʻa e pou ʻe tahá. Yang ta'e Yin vela 'o 'osi pe bulldozes; ʻOku tuʻu pe fufuuʻi ʻa e Yin taʻe ʻi ai ʻa e Yang. Ko ha pou totem palanisi — mo ha moʻui moʻui lelei — ʻokú ne ako ke fakaʻapaʻapaʻi fakatouʻosi: ʻiloʻi ʻa e taimi ke laka atu ai ki muʻá mo e taimi ke laka ki mui aí, taimi ke lea ai mo e taimi ke fanongo aí, taimi ke tekeʻi ai mo e taimi ke pukepuke aí.
to.article.yinYang.p.yin-is-not-passivity-t: ʻOku ʻikai ko ha passivity ʻa e Yin, neongo ʻe lava ke hoko ʻa e Yin ʻoku ʻikai ke siviʻí ko ha toʻo. ʻI hono tuʻunga lelei tahá ko e potó, kātakí, mo e mālohi ʻo e fakakakató. ʻOkú ne fakakakato ʻa e meʻa ʻoku kamata ʻe Yang, fakatuʻumaʻu ʻa e meʻa ʻoku fakalaveaʻi ʻe Yang, pea maʻu ʻa e mālohi ʻi he feʻunuʻakí kae ʻikai ko e fehangahangaí. Fakakaukau ki he maama ʻo e māhiná ʻi he vaí — ʻoku fakaʻata, fakatahatahaʻi, ʻave ʻa e lolotó ʻo ʻikai fie maʻu ke kaila.
to.article.yinYang.h3.where-yin-yang-go-nex: Ko e feitu'u 'oku hoko atu ai 'a Yin & Yang .
to.article.yinYang.h2.see-yin-yang-on-your-: Vakai ki he Yin & Yang ʻi Hoʻo Pou Totem .
to.article.yinYang.p.those-connection-types: ʻOku langa ʻa e ngaahi faʻahinga fehokotaki ko iá ʻi he fakavaʻe ko ʻení. ʻOku ʻikai ko ha ngaahi fetongi kinautolu ʻo e mahinoʻi ʻo e ʻuhinga ʻo e Yin mo e Yang ʻiate kinaua pē.
to.article.yinYang.p.your-four-guides-each-: Ko ho'o kau fakahinohino 'e toko fa 'oku nau takitaha 'ave ha polarity tu'u ma'u 'o e monumanu fakataha mo e 'elemeniti 'i ho'o totem pole — fakahu ho'o ngaahi fakaikiiki 'o e fanau'i ke kumi ho'o.
to.article.yinYang.p.once-you-understand-yi: Ko e taimi pe 'oku mahino ai kiate koe 'a e Yin mo e Yang ko e ngaahi 'ulungaanga tu'u-taha, 'oku faka'aonga'i kinautolu 'e he sisitemi 'i he fetu'utaki. 'I he peesi 'o e Values ​​Triangles, Rainbow ngaahi hoa ko e ngaahi hoa Yin–Yang 'oku nau fakapalanisi mo fakakakato 'a e taha mo e taha — pea ko e ngaahi hoa Shadow ko honau ngaahi inverses fakamakinito kuo pau ke fehangahangai mo e revea.
to.article.yinYang.p.in-totem-astrology-pol: 'I he Totem Astrology, 'oku kau 'a e polarity ki he monumanu 'iate ia pe. Ko e taimi ʻoku ʻasi mai ai ha Taika ʻi hoʻo pou totem — ʻi he Laumālié, ʻAtamaí, Lotó, pe Sino — ko e Yang maʻu pē ia. Ka 'asi mai ha Pusi, ko e Yin ma'u pe. Ko e element ‘i he pou ko iá ‘oku kei kehekehe pē ia ‘i ho‘o pou totem, ko ia ‘oku kehekehe ‘a e lau ‘a e Sikili Afi Yang mo ha Sikili Vai Yang — ka ‘oku ‘ikai ‘aupito liliu ‘a e natula Yang ‘o e Sikili.
to.article.nepalTime.p.read-more-of-the-per: Lau ha meʻa lahi ange ki he talanoa fakatāutaha ʻi mui ʻi he maʻu ko ʻení ʻi he peesi About.
to.article.nepalTime.h2.see-both-times-on-y: Vakai ki he ongo taimi 'i ho'o Totem Pole .
to.article.nepalTime.p.from-the-jade-empero: Mei he ‘Emipola Jade ‘i he tumutumu ‘o e mo’unga Kun Lun ki he feitu’u na’e fanau’i ai ‘a e Puta ‘i Nepal — ko e ha ‘oku tau ului ai ki he NPT kimu’a pea toki to’o ho’o fanga monumanu.
to.article.nepalTime.p.if-you-enter-your-bi: Kapau te ke fakahū ho taimi fāʻeleʻí ʻo hangē ko ia ʻoku lekooti ʻi hoʻo tohi fāʻelé — tau pehē, 3:15 PM ʻi Denver pe 9:00 AM ʻi Lonitoni — ʻoku ʻuluaki fakaʻapaʻapaʻi ʻe he meʻa fakafuofua ʻa e taimi fakalotofonua ko iá tonu. Pea, kimu'a pea toki fika'i ha pou, 'oku ne liliu 'a e momeniti ko ia ki he Nepal Time pea faka'aonga'i 'a e taimi hiki ko ia ki ho'o totem pole.
to.article.nepalTime.p.in-myths-the-jade-em: ʻI he ngaahi talatupuʻá, naʻe nofo ʻa e ʻEmipola Seiti ʻi he Kasele Seiti ʻo e ʻApasitá, ʻo māʻolunga ʻi he māmaní mo e langi ʻe tolungofulu mā tolú, ʻo fakatatau ki he ngaahi fakamatala ʻe niʻihi; pe fakatatau ki he ni‘ihi kehé, ‘i he Mo‘unga Seiti ‘i he ‘otu mo‘unga K’un Lun. Naʻe tupu heni, ʻi he matāfanga ʻo e Lepa Seiti, ha ʻAkau Seiti, ʻa ia naʻe tolungeau hono lōloa ʻo e nimá ʻi he tafaʻaki ʻe tahá pea ʻoku ʻomi ʻe hono fua seiti kulokulá ʻa e tāpuaki ʻo e moʻui taʻengatá.
to.article.nepalTime.p.on-the-calculator-re: ‘I he ngaahi ola ‘o e me’a fakafuofua, te ke sio ma’u pe ki he ongo taimi ‘i he tafa’aki ki he tafa’aki: ko e taimi na’a ke hu ki ai, ko e taimi ‘o ho kolo fanau’i, pea mo e taimi tatau Nepal (NPT) ‘oku ngaue’aki ki he fakafuofua mo’oni. Kapau naʻe fāʻeleʻi koe ʻi Kathmandu, mahalo ʻoku ʻikai ke fakahaaʻi ʻe he sifí ha liliu — ka ki he lahi taha ʻo e ngaahi fāʻeleʻi ʻi māmani lahí, ʻoku mahuʻinga ʻa e uluí.
to.article.nepalTime.p.before-your-animals-: Kimu'a pea toki fika'i ho'o fanga monumanu, 'Oku tau liliu ho'o momeniti 'o e fanau'i ki he Nepal Taimi (NPT, UTC+5:45) — ko ha liliu taimi 'oku aka 'i ha ma'u 'o e 'atamai 'oku 'ilo'i 'e he me'a ko 'eni 'oku ui ko e “Siaina Astrologys” droots 'a e sisitemi 'oku mo'oni 'a e i . ‘i he tumutumu ‘o e Mo‘unga Jade ‘i he Mo‘unga K’un Lun ‘a ia ‘oku hoko ko e kau‘āfonua fakatokelau ‘o Tibet. ‘Oku ‘omai leva ia kiate kitautolu tangatá mei he Putá, ‘a ia ‘oku pehē ‘i he tukufakaholó ko hono feitu‘u fā‘ele‘í ‘oku ‘i Nepale. Ko ia ko hono liliu ʻo e ngaahi taimi fāʻelé ki he NPT ʻoku ʻuluaki tokoniʻi ai ʻe he fanga monumanu ʻaho mo e houá ke nau laineʻi ʻa e ngaahi moʻoni ʻoku ʻiloʻi ʻe he kakai ʻi he funga ʻo e māmaní kotoa ʻi honau Lotó mo e Sino pē ʻonautolú.
to.article.nepalTime.p.the-calculator-shows: 'Oku fakahaa'i 'e he me'a fakafuofua ho taimi fanau'i fakalotofonua mo e Taimi Nepale 'oku faka'aonga'i ki ho'o ngaahi pou.
to.article.sacredRoles.p.seeker-mage-and-ro: Seeker, Mage, mo e Royal — founga kehekehe ʻe tolu ʻoku fekauʻaki ai ʻa e monumanu Triangle Values mo hono tefitoʻi mahuʻinga.
to.article.sacredRoles.p.the-same-archetypa: ʻOku toutou hoko ʻa e faʻunga tatau ʻi he Values Triangle kotoa pe. Ko e tapatolu takitaha ko ha kulupu ʻo e fanga monumanu ʻe tolu ʻoku kau ai ʻa e Seeker ʻe taha, Mage ʻe taha, mo e Tuʻi ʻe taha — ko ha founga kehekehe ʻe tolu ʻo e fekauʻaki mo e Tefitoʻi Mahuʻinga ʻo e Tapatolu ko ia. ʻOku fakafotunga ʻe he monumanu takitaha ʻa honau Tefitoʻi Tuʻunga Mahuʻinga ʻo hange ha fuka, ka ʻoku nau saiʻia ange ke hu ki ai ʻaki ʻenau fakakaukau makehe.
to.article.sacredRoles.li.the-seeker-in-eve: The Seeker — ʻI he tapatolu kotoa pe, ko e Seeker ʻa e tokotaha ʻoku ne tuli, maʻu, mo tanaki ʻa e Tefitoʻi Tuʻunga Mahuʻinga, ʻo tohoakiʻi ke tanaki ha meʻa lahi ange pe langa hake ia ʻe kinautolu ʻo makatuʻunga ʻi heʻenau ngaahi hehema. Hange ko ʻeni, ʻoku hange ʻoku tulifua maʻu pe ʻa e Power and Harmony Seekers ki honau Tefitoʻi Tuʻunga Mahuʻinga, ʻo tuli ki ai, lolotonga ia ʻoku longomoʻui ange ʻa e Kau Fekumi ki he Idealism mo e Security ʻi hono langa hake fakahangatonu ʻenau Tefitoʻi Tuʻunga Mahuʻinga, ʻo kamata mei he feituʻu ʻoku nau ʻi ai. ʻOku ngaue ʻa e Security Seeker ʻi hono fokotuʻu tahataha ʻo e ngaahi poloka ʻo e Pilamita, pea ʻoku vilitaki ʻa e Idealism ki he Tauʻataina ʻi he taimi kotoa pe ʻaki ha holi haohaoa ʻoku ne poleʻi ha taha ke taʻofi pe feinga ke tuai. Ko kinautolu ʻa e kau Fakaʻuli ʻo e kofukofu takitaha, fakapapauʻi ʻoku lava ʻa e ngaahi meʻa pea langa ʻa e ngaahi puleʻanga, teke ʻa e timi ke tokangaʻi, pea fakapapauʻi ʻoku ʻi ai ha feituʻu ke malolo ai ʻa e tokotaha kotoa pe ʻi he fakaʻosinga ʻo e poo.
to.article.sacredRoles.li.the-mage-each-mag: The Mage — ʻOku mahino ki he Mage takitaha ʻi heʻenau tapatolu ʻa honau Tefitoʻi Tuʻunga Mahuʻinga ʻo hange ha meʻa vaʻinga. Ko ia ai, ʻoku nau fiefia ke ngaue ʻi mui, ʻo fakaʻaongaʻi honau Tefitoʻi Tuʻunga Mahuʻinga mo fakaʻaongaʻi honau malohi ʻaki ʻa e ʻilo fakataumuʻa. ʻOku lahi ange ʻene vaʻinga kiate kinautolu ʻi he fakamatoato fakamatoato ʻoku fai ʻaki ʻe he ongo Fatongia kehe ʻa ʻena Tefitoʻi Tuʻunga ʻUlungaanga Mahuʻinga. ʻI he taimi ʻe niʻihi, mahalo ʻoku ʻikai ke maʻu ʻe he kau Mages honau Tefitoʻi Mahuʻinga, ka ko ha fotunga pe ʻeni ʻi ha tuʻunga ʻi ʻolunga—te nau lava ʻo hu ki ai ʻi ha faʻahinga taimi pe. ʻOku tukupa ʻa e kau Mage ki heʻenau ngaahi taumuʻa ʻo hange pe ko ha toe taha; Te nau maʻu pe ha taimi fiefia ʻi he hulohula ʻo kolosi ʻi he ngaahi ngataʻanga mo ʻahiʻahiʻi ʻa e ngaahi fakangatangata ʻi he lolotonga ʻo e fononga. Ko e vaʻinga ko e konga ia ʻo e kofukofu, ka ʻoku nau maʻu ha mahino lelei ki honau Tefitoʻi Tuʻunga Mahuʻinga ʻi he taimi ʻoku mahuʻinga moʻoni ai.
to.article.sacredRoles.li.the-royal-these-f: The Royal — ʻOku fakafotunga ʻe he fanga monumanu ko ʻeni ʻe fa ʻa honau Tefitoʻi Tuʻunga Mahuʻinga ʻi he uho ʻo ʻenau moʻui, ʻo nau hoko ko ha faʻifaʻitakiʻanga ʻo ia mo fakaʻaongaʻi ʻa e Tefitoʻi Tuʻunga Mahuʻinga ko ia ʻaki ha ongoʻi fakanatula ʻo e mafai. Koeʻuhi ko e meʻa ni, ʻoku fakahehema ʻa e niʻihi kehe ke muimui ʻi heʻenau taki, ko ia ʻoku ʻaonga ai ʻa e ngaahi lao ʻa e Spiderman: ʻoku haʻu fakataha mo e malohi lahi ʻa e fatongia lahi! ʻOku faʻa pehe ʻe he Royals ʻoku nau fakamuʻomuʻa, pea ʻoku fakaofo ʻa e fakakaukau ko ʻeni ʻi hono paasi hangatonu ki muʻa ʻi he laine pea hangatonu ki loto malie ʻi he siteisi. Ko e meʻa mahuʻinga ke manatuʻi ʻoku ʻikai ko ha faingamalie pe ke ʻi muʻa; ko ha ngaue faingataʻa foki! ʻOku fakafalala fakahangatonu ʻa e kakai kiate koe ke maʻu ha fakahinohino, ko ia ʻoku ʻaonga ʻo ʻikai ngata pe kiate koe ʻa e ongoʻi ʻoku ke ʻiloʻi ʻa e meʻa hoko ke fai ka ki he tokotaha kotoa pe ʻoku sio pe ʻoku anga fefe hono fakahoko ʻo e ngaahi meʻa. Ko e tuʻi ko ha kau taki ʻoku nau fakaʻaongaʻi lelei taha ʻa e maama ke fakamamafaʻi ʻa e meʻa ʻoku mahuʻinga.
to.article.sacredRoles.p.what-follows-on-th: Ko e meʻa ʻoku hoko atu ʻi he peesi Values Triangles ko e kanoni ia ki he tapatolu takitaha: ko e fanga monumanu ʻe tolu mo e founga ʻoku nau takitaha moʻui ʻaki hono fatongia ko e Seeker, Mage, pe Royal.
to.article.sacredRoles.four-royals.section-: Ko e Ngaahi Tuʻi ʻe Toko Fa
to.article.sacredRoles.four-royals.p.of-the: ʻI he fanga monumanu totem ʻe hongofulu ma ua, ko e fa ʻoku nau maʻu ʻa e Fatongia Toputapu ʻo e Tuʻi — taha ʻi he Tapatolu Mahuʻinga takitaha. ʻOku nau faʻu fakataha ha tuʻunga pule ʻe ua ki he zodiac: ko e Talakoni mo e Phoenix ko e Tuʻi mo e Kuini ʻo e Maama Fakasilesitiale, pea ko e Taika mo e Pea ko e Tuʻi mo e Kuini ʻo e Puleʻanga Fakamamani.
to.article.sacredRoles.four-royals.p.the-dr: ʻOku puleʻi ʻe he Talakoni mo e Finiki ʻa e tafaʻaki ʻo e ngaahi fakakaukau mo e ngaahi faʻunga ʻo e fakakaukau — ngaahi sipinga, fanongonongo, ngaahi tuʻunga moʻui, mo e faʻunga ʻo e founga ʻoku totonu ke manatuʻi ai ʻa e ngaahi meʻa kimuʻa pea toki aʻusia ʻi he sino. ʻOku maluʻi ʻe he Talakoni ʻa e malohi mo e ngaahi sipinga ʻo e lelei taha; ʻoku fakaha ʻe he Phoenix ʻa e malu ʻo fakafou ʻi he fakaʻofoʻofa, fakaʻaliʻali mo e fakapapau ʻoku lelei ʻa e meʻa kotoa pe.
to.article.sacredRoles.four-royals.p.the-ti: ʻOku puleʻi ʻe he Taika mo e Pea ʻa e tafaʻaki ʻo e ngaahi ongo fakanatula mo e aʻusia fakaʻofoʻofa — ʻa e loto fakapapau ʻoku ongoʻi ʻi he loto, mahutafea ʻi he tepile, ngaahi fakakaukau ʻoku fakahaaʻi ʻi he ngaue, mo e uouangataha ʻoku tanumaki ʻi he faʻunga ʻo e moʻui fakaʻaho. ʻOku fakahaaʻi ʻe he Taika ʻa e ueʻi fakalaumalie ko ha fakamoʻoni moʻui; ʻoku hoko ʻa e Pea ko e Tuʻi ʻo Hamoni, ko e maluʻi mo e maluʻi ʻo e melino, ʻo tauhi ʻa e ʻatakai ʻoku nofoʻi ʻe he niʻihi kehe ʻo fakafou ʻi he angaʻofa, nofoʻanga, mo e mafai.

to.page.connType.rainbow.p.yin-and-yang-com: Ko e hoa ʻo e Yin mo e Yang — ʻoku na takitaha ʻomi ʻa e lanu totonu ʻo e monumanu ʻe taha ʻo hange ha prism, ko ia ai ʻa e foʻi lea ko e ʻRainbow.ʻ Ko ha hoa hahamolofia ʻoku mahuʻinga ke fakamahuʻingaʻi ʻi he taimi kotoa pe ʻoku ke fetaulaki ai mo ia.

Ngaahi hoa Yin mo Yang — ʻOku na takitaha ʻomi ʻa e lanu totonu ʻo e monumanu ʻe taha ʻo hange ha prism, ko ia ai ʻa e foʻi lea ko e "ʻUmata" — ʻi he faʻahinga fehokotaki ko ʻeni, ʻoku ke fesiofaki moʻoni ai! Ko ha hoa hahamolofia ia, pea ʻoku totonu ke fakamahuʻingaʻi ia ʻi he taimi kotoa pe te ke fetaulaki ai mo ia! ʻOku fie maʻu ha ngaue lahi kimuʻa pea mateuteu ʻa e tokolahi ʻo e kakai ki he faʻahinga fehokotakiʻanga ko ʻeni — he ko hono moʻoni, ʻe fakaʻaliʻali kotoa hoʻo ngaahi lanu moʻoni ʻi he taimi kotoa, ko ia ʻe lelei ange ke ke fakapapauʻi ʻoku fakangingila mo ngingila kotoa ho ngaahi tafaʻaki!

to.page.connType.shadow.p.a-darkly-magnetic: A darkly magnetic Yin-Yang pairing that shows each other's hidden underbellies — revealing what might otherwise stay hidden, whether you like it or not.
to.page.connType.shadow.p.this-darkly-magne: This darkly magnetic Yin-Yang animal pairing shows each other's hidden underbellies — revealing what might otherwise stay hidden, whether you like it or not! It's a fantastic pairing for karmic work, helping you both to grow through staying committed to the bond and discovering what to work on together. I've seen it in plenty of romantic couples, even husbands and wives who've been happily married for years, but I've also seen it most easily displayed in student-teacher or parent-child pairings, where the idea of working out your faults and improving yourself is already baked into the type of relationship.

to.page.connType.mirror-opposite.p.opposite: Opposites on the zodiac wheel — six signs apart, facing each other directly across the circle. Ideal for reflecting blindspots and learning from a radically different point of view.

Opposites on the zodiac wheel — six signs apart, facing each other directly across the circle. These connections are perfect for reflecting ourselves and seeing each other's blindspots — as they are quite literally facing the opposite direction that you are! This can make for some heated arguments, but as long as you bring enough respect to the table, there's a lot to learn here from your mirrors — both of you can see things that the other cannot, so as long as you trust each other and act in good faith, this can be a very helpful and beautiful connection to have. It will most definitely keep things interesting, as they will no doubt have a different take on things than you, sometimes so radically different that you didn't even think it was possible!

Ko e ngaahi fetuʻutaki ko ʻeni ko ha kakai ʻoku nau mahuʻingaʻia tatau mo e ngaahi meʻa ʻoku ke fakamuʻomuʻa. ʻOku nau vakai ki he moʻui ʻi he founga tatau pe — ʻo tatau ai pe pe ko e feinga ke maʻu ʻa e malohi mo e taukei ʻi ha ngaue maʻuʻanga moʻui, pe ko e fekumi ki he melino mo ha toʻonga moʻui nonga. Ko e kakai ʻeni ʻoku tatataha ke ke fakamatalaʻi koe, koeʻuhi he kuo nau ʻosi fenapasi mo koe, ʻo ʻaonga ai ʻeni ki ha faʻahinga va fetuʻutaki pe: pisinisi pe taimi maloloo, famili pe kaungameʻa. to.page.connType.same-as-me.p.the-same-tote: The same totem animal at the same level — someone who shares your Spirit, Mind, Heart, or Body guide exactly. It can also be people from different 'rings' so to speak — in other words people born 12, 24, 36, or some other multiple of 12 years apart from you. For example, I am a Fire Tiger born in 1986, but I have some wonderful Tiger family and friends who are born in different Tiger rings — one of my uncles is a Water Tiger born in 1962, my son is a Metal Tiger born in 2010, and several dear friends, students, and companions are Earth Tigers born in 1998. I've also had coworkers who were born in the year of the Wood Tiger, 1974. It can be cool to see how your animals act when they've got different elemental flavors charging their energy in other people. It can also be neat to find people born on the same exact birthdate as you, so they've got all the same animal guides, or at least 3 out of 4 if the hour animal is different, and to see how they've chosen to play their hand differently than the way you've chosen to play yours — kind of like how 'identical' twins are different in many respects, but share lots of things in other areas. Free will is a powerful thing, and this connection shows that most clearly. The birth animals guiding them are the same, but the people being guided still turn out completely and wonderfully different :)

fj.home.why-totem-astrology.h2.a-tool-for-u: Yadra me Vakatadredretaki — Sega ni Vuku me Bibi Vakawadawa
fj.home.why-totem-astrology.p.at-the-heart-: E na loma ni Totem Astrology e tu na yaloqaqa: yaloqaqa me vakasamataka vinaka na nomu bula ena nomu bula, yaloqaqa me vakasamataka vinaka na veiwekani e na veiwekani kei na veiyasana ni vuvale, kei na yaloqaqa ni sa tu eso na tamata e vuravura ka vakataki iko ga me vakataki iko.
fj.home.why-totem-astrology.p.the-four-anim: Na i vakasala e va ni manumanu e solia vei keda e dua na vosa vakavanua — e dua na ka vakasisila eda rawa ni vakasamataka kevaka e dredre me tukuna na ka e tiko e loma. Ni sa via vakayacora e dua na Laca me tarogi e dua na Bulu me dui qaya e dua na kovu, eda rawa ni veitalanoataka na veibuli ka sega ni vakabibitaka vakadodonu na ka kecega. Na manumanu e vakatakila na itovo ena lomada eda sa vakayagataki kina, ka ra vakabungataki keda ena vosa me baleta na loloma.
fj.home.why-totem-astrology.p.this-is-a-too: Oqo e dua na iyaya me veivinakataki kina na noda kila e dua na kena tale eso kei na vakarautaki ni loloma — loloma e tubu mai na noda kila na duidui kei na vakabauta na duidui ni sala e vakayagataki ira kina na tamata na veika e vuravura. E sega ni vuna me ciqomi na tovo ca, ka e sega talega ni vuna me ciqomi na tovo ca ni tamata eso kevaka e vakavuna na cala. E vakarautaki me vakaraitaki na ka, sega ni me vakamatei: eda vulica kina na duidui me rawa ni da tiko vakavinaka vei keda kei vei ira tale eso vakavinaka, vakabibi ena vakarau ni qarauni, sega ni me lailai na itavi ni vakadidike.
fj.home.why-totem-astrology.p.take-what-res: Takei na veika e duatani vei iko, vakarautaka na veika e sega ni duatani — ka kua ni vakayagataka na veivakadonui oqo me vakadinadinataka na kalougata, leqa, se tiko tiko ga ena vanua e sega ni bula vakadrau. Vakanuinui kei na veimataqali iwasewase e rawa ni bula tiko ena rumu vata.
fj.home.how-totem-astrology-works.p.the-lan: Na vosa e muri ni nomu ivakaraitaki e va — vakasaqara na veirarama yadua, qai raica kece e dua ga na itaba.
fj.home.how-totem-astrology-works.h3.your-f: Na nomu iVakatagedegede e Vua Vavā
fj.home.how-totem-astrology-works.p.spirit-: Yalo, Vuniwai, Loma, kei na Yago — va na itokani manumanu mai na nomu yabaki, vula, siga, kei na aua.
fj.home.how-totem-astrology-works.p.water-w: Wai, Kui, Cagilaba, Qele, kei na Metal — e veitikina yadua ni nomu totem pole e veisautaka e dua na manumanu kei rau ena dua vei ira na Lima Elementi oqo, ka vakalougatataki na nomu iYaloyalo, Vuku, Yalo, kei na iSulu ni Yago.
fj.home.how-totem-astrology-works.p.each-to: Na manumanu yadua ni totem e tuvanaki tu ga na kena veisaututaki ena imatai ni gauna — Na Squerel e dau Yang, Na Buffalo e dau Yin, Na Tiger e dau Yang, Na Cat e dau Yin, kei na so tale.
fj.home.how-totem-astrology-works.p.four-co: E va na kena yaga bibi e vakarautaka na rua na tini na manumanu me vaka na tiga vou e vakamacalataka na ka e dau vakarautaki koya na i vakavuvuli ena levu cake.
fj.home.how-totem-astrology-works.p.within-: E na veitikina kece ni Triangle ni iVakabula, na tiga ena qito e dua vei ira na tolu na iKuri Vakatautauvata: na Vakasaqara, na Bogi, se na Turaga — tolu na sala e duidui ni vakavu e na yalo vakadodonu ni triangle ko ya.
fj.home.how-totem-astrology-works.p.a-simpl: E dua na veisau ni gauna rawarawa ki na gauna ni Nepal (NPT) ena loma ni vakadewataki — e dua na ituvatuva vinaka me wilika na veisemi ni siga kei na aua.
fj.home.how-totem-astrology-works.btn.how-i: Na iYaloyalo ni Vakasama — raici taucoko
fj.home.h2.a-revolution-in-how-we-understan: E dua na Veisau Bula ena iVakarau Kena Vinakati me da Vakarorogo na Veiwekani kei na Veiwekani Eso Kei Na Veika Dredre e Lomadodonu
fj.home.p.untangle-the-complexities-of-life: Wasea na leqa ni bula ena vuravura vou oqo, ni vakadigitali, ena vuku ni veitokoni vakaitaukei ena na nodra yaco mai na yalayala ni veisautaki e tolu na totemi manumanu e o sa tuva kina.
fj.home.p.meet-your-four-totem-guides-and: Vosota na nomu totem e va na veikauwaitaki ka kunea na gagadre ni loma o sa bulataka me wasea.
fj.home.p.understand-the-totem-dynamics-bet: Vakarorogo ki na veikilai ni totem vei kemuni kei na nomuni itokani — vakarorogo, veivakaoti, kei na inaki ena veitokani.
fj.home.p.map-totem-patterns-across-your-fa: Vakatadre vakatabakidua na ivakarau batabata ena nomu matavuvale me vakavinakataka na veisau ni gauna sa oti kei na vakamareqeta na veinanumi.
fj.home.p.align-your-work-and-ambitions-wit: Tavela na nomu cakacaka kei na nomu gagadre ena veiqaravi ni nomu totemi kei na gauna e vakabulai ira.
fj.home.p.find-the-people-and-opportunities: Sewai ira na tamata kei na veikilai e veivakadeitaki kei na nomu ivakarau — veivakamarautaki, vanua ni lewe ena dua na dua, kei na i matanitu vou.
fj.home.p.opt-in-with-your-four-totem: Vuetaki ena nomu uluna e va ni manumanu totala ka raica tale eso ena lisi makawa — taumada ena veiwekani ena Rainbow, Shadow, Trine, se Mirror.
fj.home.p.discover-your-four-totem-animal-g: Raica na nomu veiqaravi lvica totoka e va ni manumanu — Vakayalo, Vakamareqeti, Vakaloloma, kei na Vakayago — mai na nomu siga ni vakacuru, gauna, kei na koro.

fj.home.p.every-session-follows-a-clear-com: E veisoliyaki kece na veivosaki ena dua na iwalewale duidui, marautaki mai na itikotiko vakawasoma ki na buli e muri.
fj.home.p.choose-a-service-and-send-a: Digitaka e dua na veiqaravi ka vakauta e dua na itukutuku vata kei na nomu siga ni yabaki, gauna, kei na vanua ke o tiko kina.
fj.home.p.we-ll-confirm-details-and-book: Keitou na vakadeitaka na itukutuku ka na volia e dua na veivosaki ni vidio ena gauna e vinaka vei iko.

fj.page.about.p.from-the-four-pillars-of-de: Mai na Veitaba Vina va ni Yaloyalo me yacova na gauna ni Nepal — na italanoa ni sala ena sotia kina vakadua na Totem Astrology.
fj.page.about.p.relationship-counselor-mult: Vakasaqa ni Veimaliwai, Dauvakatumu ni iVakatakilakila Veimataqali Levu, kei na Dauvakatini ni Totem Astrology
fj.page.about.p.i-developed-totem-astrology: Au vakatorocaketaka o Totem Astrology ena loma ni disa vula se tolu ena veisiga ni noqu vale ni veivakasaqa, me vakasamataka na vuravura, veitalanoa kei na vuravura raraba, ka vulica e levu na kena ituvatuva ni veisiko vakavalevoni. Au kunea na nodra iwasewase bibi ena ivakarau ni vakaViti ni Four Pillars of Destiny ena iVakatagedegede vakaSaina — ni a ra dau vakayagataka e so na tamata na iyaya oqo me baleta na kena vakayacori na isau kei na kena isiga, na noqu vakasama e tukuna vei au ni sa tu kina e dua na ka me da vulica e vakatau ena noda ituvaki vakarua vakawainimate.
fj.page.about.p.my-first-clue-was-the-four: Na noqu isosomi tu vakataki au e va na tikina: na Tui, Vula, Siga, kei na Au. Me tiko ga vei ira na iYau, Vuku, Yalo, kei na Yago! Au sa bulia na wiliwili, ia e dua na ka e sega ni dodonu. Na iwasewase ena ruku ni iTukutuku e dina tiko vata kei na Tui kei na Vula, ia na yasana ena ruku kei na Siga kei na Au e sega ni duatani tiko kei na dina ni vei ira era tu ena lomaqu. Au sa vakayagataka vakalevu qori me noda yabaki me yacova ni sa qai vakasama vata na noqu ganena: Na iTavaya e Va e tukuna na nona ituvatuva mai vua na Ratu Jade, ena so na itovo sa solia vakadua vei keda mai vua ga o Buddha.
fj.page.about.p.since-the-buddha-s-traditio: Oti na vanua vakavanua ni nodra buli na Buddha e Nepal, au a vakatulewa meu tekivu veisautaka na gauna ni bula ni tamata ki na gauna vaka-Nepal ni bera niu vakuria na nodra itukutuku ki na Calculator ni Tikina Vauvau — ka toso mai ga, voilà! Na itukutuku vou ni bula oqo a vakatotolotaka kina na veika taucoko. Ia oqo ena noda itukutuku vaka-lawa, na Totem Calculator e cakava taucoko oqo me baleta iko: vakacuruma ga na nomu siga, gauna, kei na vanua ni bula, ka sa vakalutuma oti na veisautaki ni gauna ni bera ni dolava na nomu manumanu e va. Oqo ka o raica oqo e dau rawa vinaka me yaga vata kei na nomu Yalo, Vuku, Yawa, kei na Yago!
fj.page.about.p.i-like-to-think-of-these: Au taleitaka me vakasamataka na ika e va oqo me vaka nai vola e soli vei iko ena tovo ni bula oqo. E buli tu mai loma me rawa ni o vakayagataka, ia e sega ni vakatokai na nomu ituvaki. Sa tu vei iko na gauna meda cakava kina eso na veivakatorocaketaki, se meda sega ni vakasamataka vakadua qai veivakacacani eso ke o vinakata! Ia e vakadeitaka na kila na ka o vakayagataka ni sa tekivu oti na qito.
fj.page.about.p.a-central-tenet-of-totem-as: E dua na ivakaraitaki bibi ni Totem Astrology na nuitaki — nuitaki me rawa ni vakarautaki vinaka tale na nomu kilaka ena nomu bula, nuitaki me vinaka tale na nomu kila na nomu itokani kei na tamata ni vale, kei na nuitaki ni tiko e dua, se e vuqa, e tiko e matadra era vakadonuya kei iko ena ka dina nomu tovo. Na veivuke e va e solia vei keda e dua na vosa e vakaitavi vata: e dua na ka vakayagataka me vakatokai na ka e yaco vua na noda bula ni vakatolu, me rawa ni da veitalanoa ena noda duidui ena sega ni veisau na veitalanoa e veisau kina na veivakatalataki.
fj.page.about.p.this-is-not-an-excuse-for: Oqo e sega ni cavuti ni ca ni iwalewale, se vuna me vakatulewataki kina na ca ni iwalewale ni tamata tale eso. E dua oqo na iyaya me kilai kina na veivakawati kei na solia vakacegu vei ira tale eso — vakacegu e buli mai na kilaka ni duidui ni veiwekani kei na vakailesilesi ni iwalewale duidui ni veiwekani. Keitou raica ni dua na tamata ka duidui na gauna ni cicivaki ena lewe ni nona siga ni marautaki, e rawa ni tauri kaya na loloma vakarairai ni Cat se Deer, se na tautauvata ni Tiger se Horse ni maroroya me tekivutaka na cakacaka, keitou ganita na matadraki ni ka e rawa ni yaco e loma — ena kena sasaga meu vakavinakataka na lomana kei na marautaka na cala ni tamata tale eso, sega ni vakayagataki na ca.
fj.page.about.p.everybody-else-has-their-ow: Era tiko ga ena tamata kece eso nodra vei manumanu e va tale ga, ka e rawa ni vukea meda kila na ka eda cakava kece me rawa ni da kila vinaka na yakavi kei na rawarawa ni veiwekani, ka marautaka na duidui ni kena ivakarau me kua ni veivakamatei. Na manumanu duidui e sa tu vakataki koya na kaukauwa, ka na totem e tu vakataki koya na kila bibi.
